jobs.title: Software Engineer, AI Coding Tasks
jobs.description: We're looking for experienced software engineers to build AI coding tasks from a codebase they know well. US$1,000 per task, and you can do as many tasks as you want. You turn a real change from a repository you know into a task that today's best AI coding models struggle with: hard for the models, but fair for a skilled engineer. Your tasks are used to measure and train AI coding models. Remote, any location. US$1,000 per task that passes review. Minimum of one task a week, about 10 hours a week. How it works Apply. Complete a short screener interview and upload your resume. Propose. Once you're selected, pick a change from a repository you know and submit a short proposal. We approve it or suggest a better candidate. Build. In our platform, set up the repository as it was before the change, then write the brief, the correct solution and the grading checks. Stress-test. Try lazy, incorrect and shortcut solutions and make sure your checks catch them. Model testing. Run your task against leading AI models until strong models often fail but a skilled engineer can clearly solve it. Review. A reviewer checks your task and you revise it. Most tasks take more than one round. Next task. Once your task is accepted, start another. Requirements 2+ years of professional software engineering Code merged into a public open-source repository, ideally one you know well. A private codebase you own may also qualify (not employer or client code) Strong in at least one of Python, TypeScript, Go, Rust, Java or C++ Solid with Docker, Linux, Git and automated testing Regular use of an AI coding tool Experience writing tests, rubrics or evaluation criteria, ideally for AI models You can explain a change clearly and concisely, in your own words At least 10 hours a week, starting now A secure personal or work computer (no public or shared machines) Nice to have Deep expertise in one area, such as databases, compilers, distributed systems, security or infrastructure Experience building agent tasks or RL environments Terms US$1,000 for each task that passes our quality review, paid directly to you Once your proposal is qualified, you sign Askable's contract and accept its terms The work is used for AI training. The change and your solution must be your own, and you must be free to license them to us Don't publish the work anywhere: no public pull request or public fork Apply at https://www.askable.com/experts/roles/senior-software-engineer

jobs.description: At Klim, we work with farmers and food companies to make regenerative agriculture scalable and financially rewarding for farmers. Through our platform, we help farmers restore soil health, increase biodiversity and capture carbon while creating new, reliable income streams. We’re a Berlin-based AgriTech startup backed by $22M in Series A funding, partnering with global food leaders such as Nestlé and Kaufland to reduce emissions across their supply chains and build long-term resilience. Since 2020, we’ve supported 3,500 farmers managing over 900,000 hectares. If you’re passionate about building a sustainable food system and driving real climate impact, join us and help create a healthier planet! Your mission: As our (Senior) Finance Manager, you will run all aspects of Finance at Klim. From HGB accounting and the monthly and annual close, through day-to-day financial operations, to audits, controlling and finance projects — you own the full breadth of the finance function end-to-end. This is a hands-on individual contributor role with unusually broad responsibility: you are the person who keeps our financial engine room running accurately, reliably and on time, and who continuously makes it simpler, faster and more automated. You are supported by a working student whose work you steer, and you report directly to our COO. This role is a great fit for you if you are a finance all-rounder who wants genuine ownership of the entire finance function and the opportunity to make a real impact from day one. With a broad mix of strategic, tactical and operational responsibility, you’ll have plenty of room to shape how we work, improve what’s already there and build an automated Finance function. Your responsibilities: Own our HGB-compliant accounting: run the month-end and year-end close and deliver accurate, timely financial statements with our external accountants. Run financial operations end-to-end: accounts receivable and payable, tax-compliant invoicing, payment runs, expense flows and cash management. Manage statutory reporting and tax topics (e.g. Jahresabschluss / annual financial statements, VAT) together with our external tax advisors. Prepare and manage the annual audit: audit files, documentation and communication with auditors. Support controlling and strategic finance topics: management reporting, analyses and spreadsheet-based models that inform business decisions. Be the driving force behind the introduction of innovative AI-based processes, building a state-of-the-art efficient and effective finance setup. Manage and develop our finance working student. Your profile: 3–5 years of experience in accounting and/or finance roles. Solid HGB accounting experience, including month-end and year-end close. Hands-on experience in financial operations (invoicing, payments, expense management, cash). You are highly autonomous and have a hands-on mentality: you are comfortable owning the full breath of the finance function. You take responsibility for getting things done and you are very good at collaborating with internal and external stakeholders. jobs.title: Co-Founder | Growth, Community & Partnerships (m/w/d)
jobs.description: Co-Founder | Growth, Community & Partnerships (m/w/d) Standort: München (überwiegend vor Ort) Start: Voraussichtlich Februar/März 2027 Compensation: EXIST Gründungsstipendium, 2.500 € monatlich für Hochschulabsolventen, plus geplante Beteiligung am Unternehmen Über uns Wir sind Pierre-Louis Suckrow und Kerim Anater. Unsere akademischen und beruflichen Hintergründe liegen in Informatik, Design & Computation und Human Computer Interaction. Gemeinsam entwickeln wir eine neue Plattform für die Organisation und Zusammenarbeit in der digitalen Musikproduktion. Unser Produkt soll es ermöglichen, verschiedene Projektstände und ihre Entstehung nachzuvollziehen, frühere Versionen wiederherzustellen und Projekte zwischen unterschiedlichen Produktionsumgebungen auszutauschen. Damit möchten wir mehr Raum für musikalisches Experimentieren schaffen, den organisatorischen Aufwand in kreativen Arbeitsprozessen reduzieren und die Zusammenarbeit zwischen Musikschaffenden erleichtern. Ein erster funktionsfähiger Prototyp für Ableton Live existiert bereits. Wir sind Teil des WaveLab Inkubators Batch #7 und im Wintersemester Teil der Munich Music Labs. Aktuell bereiten wir unsere Bewerbung für das EXIST Gründungsstipendium vor. Zur Ergänzung unserer technischen und produktorientierten Kompetenzen suchen wir ein drittes Gründungsmitglied, das insbesondere die Kommunikation nach außen, den Aufbau von Kontakten und die Entwicklung von Kundenbeziehungen mitgestaltet. jobs.title: Senior Consulting Engineer
jobs.description: <h3>The team</h3> <p>MongoDB's Application Modernization Platform (AMP) organization is the front door of our modernization business. In our Data Migration practice we move production data - safely, repeatably, at enterprise scale - from relational estates (Oracle, SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MySQL) and from NoSQL platforms (Apache Cassandra, Azure Cosmos DB, Amazon DocumentDB) onto MongoDB. We do this both as standalone migration programmes and as the data workstream inside larger application-modernization engagements, using MongoDB's own tooling - Relational Migrator, Cluster-to-Cluster Sync, Atlas Stream Processing - alongside the open-source and cloud-native pipeline ecosystem.&nbsp;</p> <p>Our mission is to help our customers be successful by leading end-to-end their journey to MongoDB. In an era where AI agents handle routine migration mechanics - such as workload assessments, schema and query translations, and large-scale validation - our consultants focus on the high-judgment decisions that directly mitigate risk. Joining us now means helping draft the playbooks while they are actively being defined. We are seeking builders who prefer creating new frameworks over following legacy instructions.</p> <p>This role will be based remotely in Germany.</p> <h3>Position expectations</h3> <p>Delivery</p> <ul> <li>Plan and lead the technical delivery of data migration engagements end to end: source estate assessment, migration strategy and wave planning, schema and data-model transformation, pipeline build, validation, and production cutover with minimal downtime</li> <li>Design and operate change data capture (CDC) pipelines for zero and near-zero-downtime migrations - using Kafka and the connector ecosystem, Debezium and comparable log-based CDC tooling, and cloud-native replication services</li> <li>Bring genuine platform depth on the estates our customers are leaving: Cassandra data modeling and anti-patterns, Cosmos DB (Core and Mongo API) partitioning and RU economics, DocumentDB's compatibility surface - and use it to de-risk what the customer cannot see coming</li> <li>Work shoulder to shoulder with enterprise customers - architects, DBAs, platform teams and executives - from whiteboard to war room</li> <li>Own the full consulting lifecycle for your engagements, from planning and agenda-setting through post-engagement follow-up, surfacing risks and further opportunities back to Sales and Professional Services</li> </ul> <p>Pre-sales and growth</p> <ul> <li>Partner with Solutions Architects, Engagement Managers and account teams to scope and size migration opportunities, shape statements of work and estimation models, and give sales well-founded confidence in what is achievable and what it will take</li> <li>Cultivate your reputation as a migrations SME and trusted advisor, internally and in the market, and positively influence your own utilization through proactive customer engagement</li> <li>Identify services opportunities in our customers, new workloads or estates to be migrated or product improvements the customer could benefit from</li> </ul> <p>Building the practice</p> <ul> <li>Build and harden the AI tooling that makes migrations faster and safer: agents for automated estate assessment, schema and data-model conversion, query and code translation, and large-scale data validation - and fold what works into the standard delivery methodology</li> <li>Turn field experience into reusable assets: migration playbooks, reference architectures, estimation models, tooling improvements and enablement for the wider team</li> <li>Partner with Product and Engineering to bring field reality into MongoDB's product and migration-tooling roadmap</li> </ul>

jobs.title: Senior Category Manager, Womenswear UK/EU
jobs.description: <div class="content-intro"><p><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>ABOUT QUINCE</strong></span></p> <p>Quince is a destination for builders, creators, innovators, and operators who want to come together and challenge the status quo. Our mission is simple: make really high quality essentials for really low prices, fairly and sustainably. We deliver on that mission through a unique manufacturer-to-consumer (M2C) model eliminating the layers of traditional retail that add cost and result in consumers paying more than they need to. We find, build relationships with, and work directly with the manufacturing partners behind some of the world’s finest products. From there, our teams design smart, efficient operational processes&nbsp; and build and deploy proprietary technology, AI, and analytics to help us scale fast.</p> <p>What began with a small assortment of elevated basics has quickly grown into a cross-category brand spanning apparel, accessories, home goods, and more. Today, tens of millions of people across a growing number of countries come – and return – to Quince because they trust us to deliver.</p> <p><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>OUR CULTURE</strong></span></p> <p>Quince is a culture built for builders by builders. Our way of working starts with a blank sheet of paper. We question conventional thinking, use technology and data to uncover new opportunities, and move quickly to turn ideas into reality. We aren’t interested in replicating how others do retail. We’re building a better way – at a speed and scale unlike anything that’s been done before.</p> <ul> <li>We dream big and chase the hard problems others shy away from. Rejecting long-held assumptions is part of our company's DNA.&nbsp; Where conventional wisdom says you have to choose – soft or durable, speed or rigor, quality or price – we ask why that trade-off has to exist in the first place.</li> <li>Our pace is fast and the bar is high because our customers expect a lot from us and we refuse to let them down. We believe the best results come from challenging ourselves, learning from one another, and building on each other's strengths.&nbsp;</li> <li>Here, responsibility is not determined by role, tenure, or seniority. Every team member - no matter their level - has the opportunity to drive our business and shape our trajectory.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <p>If you’re someone who likes to imagine new possibilities and build better systems rather than plug-in to outdated ones, Quince is the place for you.</p></div><p><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>THE ROLE</strong></span></p> <p><strong>Senior Category Manager, Women's UK/EU</strong></p> <p>We are seeking a <strong>Senior Category Manager, Women's UK/EU</strong><strong>&nbsp;</strong>to join our growing team. This role is suited to a data-driven product obsessed all-rounder. jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description: About Lio Build AI that runs inside the world's largest enterprises. Everyone is building AI. Very few are making it work at enterprise scale. At Lio, we're building the AI workforce for procurement. Our AI agents automate complex, mission-critical workflows across procurement, logistics, and finance for some of the world's largest companies. Backed by leading investors including a16z and Y Combinator, we're growing fast and tackling some of the most complex challenges in enterprise AI. We're looking for people who want to take ownership, solve hard problems, and build technology that delivers real business impact. The Role We're looking for a Product Manager – Pre-Sales & Go-to-Market who can bridge the gap between what enterprise customers need, what our engineers build, and how we bring our products to market. At Lio, product decisions don't happen in isolation. Every customer conversation, sales cycle, and implementation reveals new opportunities to make our AI agents more valuable. Your mission is to turn those insights into action. You'll work directly with our Sales, Engineering, Marketing, and Implementation teams to understand customer needs, shape product positioning, strengthen our go-to-market strategy, and identify opportunities that drive revenue. You'll be deeply involved in enterprise sales cycles, helping our teams communicate the value of our AI agents, build compelling business cases, and win customers. This isn't traditional Product Management. Our engineers own their features and make most product decisions. You won't manage a backlog or spend your time writing detailed specifications. jobs.title: Sales Manager
jobs.description: Win new restaurants across Germany and help build one of our fastest-growing markets from the ground up. Full-time About SOUS SOUS exists to give independent restaurants the same acquisition-to-retention infrastructure that only chains and delivery platforms could previously afford. We build it as one connected data layer, replacing the fragmented stack most restaurants run today: a listings tool here, a separate storefront there, and no CRM at all. Spotlight owns discovery, as search shifts from Google links to AI assistants recommending where to eat. Commerce owns the transaction and, critically, the guest relationship that marketplaces have been extracting for a decade. Every order through that owned channel generates data that sharpens the next cycle of visibility, personalisation and retention, compounding in the restaurant's favour instead of the platform's. Our long-term bet is simple. As AI becomes the default interface for "where should I eat", the restaurants that own their guest data and their presence in that layer will keep the margin, and the ones still renting both from marketplaces will not. We are building the infrastructure to make the first outcome the default, not the exception. We are a team of 27, working from our headquarters on the Vijzelstraat in Amsterdam city centre, and we are growing fast across the Netherlands, Germany and South Africa. About the role SOUS helps independent food and beverage entrepreneurs grow by building what we believe will be the last employee a restaurant owner ever has to hire that touches a screen. After a strong start in the Netherlands, Germany is now one of our most important growth markets, and we are scaling our team there quickly. As Sales Manager Germany you bring SOUS to independent restaurants across the country. You are one of the first people building our German sales team, which means real ownership, a big market to win and a fast track to grow with it. Your team You join the Sales team Germany and report to the Sales Lead Germany, as part of the international sales organisation led by our Global Head of Sales. You work closely with our teams in Amsterdam across Growth, Partnerships and Merchant Success. Tasks Your role in this growth Focus fully on new business and drive consistent growth in the single and multi-outlet restaurant segments in Germany Own your complete sales funnel: follow up warm leads, create new opportunities, close deals and nurture customer relationships Work with autonomy and full responsibility, paired with clear targets Collaborate closely with the Sales Lead Germany on regional expansion and larger accounts Help shape the German sales playbook as we scale the team Follow a defined progression path towards Senior Sales Manager or other commercial roles Key responsibilities Build and manage a strong outbound and inbound pipeline in the German food and beverage market Run consultative sales conversations with chefs and restaurant owners, remote and on site Convert both hot and cold leads into qualified opportunities and closed deals Manage the entire sales cycle, from prospecting through to onboarding Share local market insights with marketing and product, from Lieferando dynamics to regional differences Requirements 2 to 6 years of sales experience; a SaaS, hospitality or startup background is preferred Strong communication skills with a consultative, solution-oriented approach Comfortable working with targets, CRM workflows and structured outreach Affinity with the food and beverage sector, AI and digital products An existing network in the German restaurant or food and beverage industry is a plus Native or fluent German and good English Willing to travel for merchant visits and regular team days in Amsterdam Benefits Base salary of €50,000 to €62,000 gross per year, depending on experience Uncapped bonus structure 25 holiday days plus public holidays Remote working in Germany, with regular team days at our headquarters on the Vijzelstraat

jobs.description: Master Data Management Analyst, Global Business Services – 6 Month Fixed Term Contract   At IVC Evidensia, we are a leading veterinary services provider in Europe and North America with more than 2,500 clinics and hospitals across 19 countries and around 42,000 employees. We aim to have an extraordinary impact on animal lives, supporting in the region of 25,000 animals every single day across our international network. IVC Evidensia exists to champion the long-term health and welfare of animals and deliver our purpose of Healthy Animals, Happy Owners.   Our GBS Master Data Management Analyst is accountable for managing the finance master data requests from key stakeholders within both Group Finance and local in-country finance teams. This will involve triaging requests and ensuring that appropriate governance controls are executed, before maintaining master data in business systems. This work will need to adhere to service level agreement timescales and MDM governance rules and standards.   The MDM Analyst will partner with business master data requesters, Global Process Owners and subject matter experts to ensure that Enterprise Structure and Finance master data is maintained correctly in business systems. This will require an understanding of how master data flows across different business systems and an appreciation of related, core business transactions. The MDM Analyst will train and onboard business master data requesters and approvers.   In this role you will support the MDM Lead by executing actions to improve MDM processes and master data quality. This will often involve investigating issues, problem solving and suggesting improvement actions. The MDM Analyst will document processes and standards as required, as well as co-ordinating data cleansing activities to improve data quality in addition to having performance management reporting oversight with our BPO partner.   IVC Evidensia are going through an exciting period of significant change, and you will need to embrace and drive that change. This is a fantastic opportunity for someone with strong relationship, business acumen, project coordination and analytical mindset to contribute to the organisation’s growth.   This role is initially being offered on a 6 month fixed term contract basis.     Key Accountabilities/Responsibilities:   * Manage MDM request queue for Enterprise Structure and Finance-related master data, ensuring that requests are processed according to service level agreement timescales and necessary governance controls. * Triage requests and determine the appropriate course of action according to business rules. * Confirm requirements for hierarchy and mapping table maintenance with business SMEs. * Maintain master data in business systems in line with rules and standards. * Train and onboard new business master data requesters and owners as required. * Support MDM Leads to implement master data quality standards and processes to ensure data accuracy, consistency, completeness, and reliability. * Document master data processes to cover full lifecycle of activities, ensuring these are modified as the business evolves. * Work with MDM Leads and business SMEs to review and improve master data processes. * Performance manage our MDM team situated with our BPO partner Genpact * Performance manage leverage KPI’s and support regular reporting of performance * Develop and implement master data validation checks and routines. * Ensure master data accuracy through systematic validation procedures. * Collaborate with external sources and partners for data enrichment where appropriate. * Assist in troubleshooting master data quality issues and anomalies. * Provide operational insights for master data improvement initiatives. * Coordinate and execute master data cleansing routines. * Collaborate with data owners, requesters and subject matter experts to identify and resolve master data issues.     Experience/

jobs.description: Qui sommes-nous ? Télécom Paris, école de l’IMT (Institut Mines-Télécom) et membre fondateur de l’Institut Polytechnique de Paris, est une grande école du top 5 des écoles d’ingénieurs généralistes françaises. La Raison d’Être de Télécom Paris est de former, imaginer et entreprendre pour concevoir des modèles, des technologies et des solutions numériques au service d’une société et d’une économie respectueuses de l’humain et de son environnement. Nous recherchons notre futur(e) post-doctorant(e) en évaluation de la vulnérabilité d’un réseau d’accès Télécom de type PON (Passive Optical Network) vis-à-vis d’écoutes potentielles par DAS (Distributed Acoustic Sensor) pour rejoindre le département Communications et Electronique (COMELEC). Cette étude se situe dans le cadre du projet « Ecoute Acoustique Terrestre » (EAT) RAPID (Régime d’Appui Pour l’Innovation Duale), fruit d’un partenariat entre la société Febus Optics et Télécom Paris.  La mesure de vibrations acoustiques distribuées par fibre optique (DAS, Distributed Acoustic Sensing) est une technologie récente, dont les applications ne cessent de se diversifier. On peut citer par exemple la détection d’intrusion en surveillance périmétrique, les mesures sismiques, le diagnostic de puits (pétrole, géothermie), etc. La bande passante de la mesure, de sub-Hertz à la centaine de kiloHertz, permet également d’envisager la captation de la bande audio, et donc de réaliser des mesures audios sur une fibre optique. Il est ainsi possible d’utiliser le réseau optique télécom d’un bâtiment pour réaliser des écoutes, en utilisant un système DAS modifié, intégrant des artéfacts matériels particuliers (enroulement, antennes, connecteurs) au voisinage de la zone d’écoute et un traitement du signal spécifique pour obtenir des performances suffisantes. Le cadre de ce Postdoc est d’évaluer la vulnérabilité d’un réseau télécom vis-à-vis d’écoutes potentielles par DAS. Le branchement sur un réseau optique Telecom local en fonctionnement nécessite de s’adapter à son architecture, notamment en termes de plan de longueur d’onde. L’audit des systèmes de télécommunication afin d’en évaluer la vulnérabilité constitue un enjeu majeur du réseau télécom. Un exemple de configuration d’un réseau d’accès est décrit dans la figure ci-après. Depuis le réseau Backbone, à partir du ‘Central Office’, les signaux télécoms sont acheminés chez les abonnés via le PON (Passive Optical Network). À l’intérieur des bâtiments, un réseau FTTX (Fiber To The X=H home, X=R room, X=O office, etc) ou un réseau local LAN (Local Area Network) optique servent respectivement à acheminer le signal optique jusqu’au terminal final ou à communiquer entre deux terminaux locaux via une liaison optique. Le PON comprend une fibre nourricière (Feeder Fiber) puis, au moins, un coupleur 1×N. Le codage de l’information est alors un mélange de multiplexage en longueur d’onde grossier (C-WDM) et de multiplexage temporel (TDM). Chaque voie de sortie du coupleur 1×N est envoyée vers des groupes de 1 à n abonnés à travers, au moins, un filtre qui sélectionne la longueur d’onde qui leur est allouée. Le signal après ce filtre est alors monochromatique et codé TDM. Le dernier coupleur 1×n répartie le signal chez les n abonnés. Ce PON comprend donc, entre autres, des coupleurs passifs qui divisent les signaux vers différents abonnés mais aussi des connecteurs, soudures, etc. L’objectif de ce Postdoc est de faire un état des lieux des différents types de réseau mis en place et d’en évaluer les conséquences sur la capacité de mesures DAS : ·         Description des différents types de réseaux locaux existants, ·         Etats des lieux des différents types de transmission : CWDM, TDM, … ·         Quels sont les différents points d’accès pour une mesure DAS ? ·         Comment discrim

jobs.description: Rejoindre Mines Saint-Étienne , c’est s’engager dans une institution où la science et l’innovation bâtissent un avenir plus durable . Une école d’excellence où chacun   a l’opportunité de révéler son plein potentiel et de contribuer à relever les défis de demain . Classée parmi les meilleures écoles d’ingénieurs en France et reconnue mondialement, notre école, membre de l’Institut Mines-Télécom, forme les talents de demain tout en contribuant activement à relever les grands défis industriels, numériques et environnementaux. Avec nous, vous intégrez une communauté de 500 collaborateurs, 2500 étudiants, et participez à un projet ambitieux : conjuguer excellence académique, recherche d’avant-garde et impact sociétal positif.   L’Institut Mines-Télécom fédère les grandes écoles françaises autour des défis industriels majeurs, numériques, énergétiques et écologiques. Avec ses 8 Grandes Écoles publiques et 2 écoles filiales, il est le premier institut public dédié aux ingénieurs et managers. Ensemble, nous imaginons et construisons un avenir durable, en formant les acteurs qui façonneront les transitions de demain.   À Mines Saint-Étienne, nos centres de recherche sont le cœur battant de notre École. Pensés comme de véritables hubs d’innovation, nos cinq Centres de Formation et de Recherche  articulent leurs expertises autour de grands enjeux industriels, environnementaux, sociétaux et technologiques. Leur mission ? Imaginer le monde de demain en alliant excellence académique et impact concret. Vous rêvez d’une industrie propre, efficace et durable ? Le centre SPIN en fait sa priorité. Énergie, environnement, procédés industriels… on y conçoit des systèmes pour produire  mieux, avec moins. L’objectif ?  Limiter l’impact environnemental, réduire la consommation énergétique et booster l’efficacité. 🔧 Dans un monde en pleine mutation, nos équipes déploient leur créativité scientifique pour accompagner l’ industrie du futur.  Et vous, prêt·e à innover à nos côtés ? 🎯 Ce que nous attendons de vous En tant que post-doctorant, vous êtes au cœur de nos missions en recherche et innovation affecté au Centre SPIN. Le centre « Sciences des Processus Industriels et Naturels » (SPIN) est un centre de recherche, d’enseignement et de transfert technologique reconnu pour son expertise en Génie des Procédés appliqué aux solides divisés. Il est au service de l’innovation pour les entreprises industrielles confrontées à la transition numérique et environnementale. La personne recrutée sera intégrée dans le département « Procédés de Transformation des Solides et Instrumentation » (PTSI) et dans le Laboratoire Georges Friedel UMR CNRS 5307. Le projet proposé ici consistera à développer de capteurs de gaz à partir de matériaux fonctionnels. L’étude des interactions solide/gaz sera menée en parallèle des caractérisations électriques sous atmosphère gazeuse complexe (bancs de test avec génération contrôlée de polluants). Cette étude sera menée en collaboration avec des chercheurs de IMT Mines Albi qui ont en charge la synthèse des matériaux sensibles et de IMT Atlantique pour l’intégration ultérieure du capteur dans des vêtements. Dans le cadre du développement de capteurs, les matériaux sensibles seront déposés sur des supports préalablement équipés d’électrodes. Cette phase devra être optimisée afin de pouvoir effectuer des caractérisations reproductibles. La stabilité, la sensibilité à différents gaz et la sélectivité à un gaz donné seront étudiées. Pour cela, des tests sous gaz cibles seront réalisés et analysés, en atmosphère simple dans un premier temps jusqu’à des tests sous atmosphères plus représentatives d’un environnement réel. Ensuite, des études d’adsorption seront réalisées, un équipement de chimisorption sera utilisé afin d’étudier l’interaction solide (matériau sensible) / gaz et permettra d’apporter une compréhension sur les mécanismes de détection, de capture ou de traitement. 🔍 Ce que nous rechercho

jobs.title: Tender Manager
jobs.description: Do you want to take ownership of how tenders are won, rather than simply contributing to them? Valcon is looking for an experienced Bid Manager to take the lead across the entire bid and tender process. From identifying and qualifying opportunities to defining the strategy, coordinating decision-making, managing stakeholders, safeguarding quality and evaluating results. The primary focus will be on European public tenders. This is explicitly not a traditional bid writing role. Rather than spending your days writing proposals yourself, you ensure that the right people deliver the strongest possible content at the right time. You create structure, challenge subject-matter experts, safeguard the strategy and quality, and keep stakeholders aligned throughout the process. But in case of emergency it is important for you to also be able to write a tender yourself, which occasionally will happen. The principle is simple: don’t write it yourself – enable the team to write it better. What will you do? As Bid Manager, you will be responsible for the end-to-end management of bids and tenders. You will oversee the full tender pipeline and take the lead on complex bid processes involving multiple disciplines, seniority levels and stakeholder interests. Your responsibilities include: Centrally identifying, qualifying and prioritising relevant tenders and commercial opportunities; Organising and facilitating Go/No-Go decisions and according to the required approval process; Developing and safeguarding the bid strategy; Translating it into a clear plan and structured tender process; Independently leading multidisciplinary bid teams consisting of partners, managers, consultants, subject matter experts and in some cases external stakeholders; Managing timelines, progress, compliance and quality throughout the entire bid process; Organising reviews and critically assessing contributions before submission; Safeguarding legal and procedural requirements, particularly for European public tenders; Reporting on the tender pipeline, results and performance to the CRO; Evaluating completed bids and systematically translating lessons learned into improvements; Further developing governance, processes, tooling, knowledge management and reporting within the Tender Desk; Using data, technology and AI to make the bid process smarter, more efficient and more effective; Training and coaching colleagues who contribute to bids and helping to increase bid management maturity across the organisation; In case of emergency, it is important to also be able to write tenders yourself. As Bid Manager, you ensure that the overall process works: that the right people contribute, deadlines are met, decisions are made and strategy, quality and content come together. You are a Bid Manager, not a Bid Writer That distinction is important. At Valcon, consultants, partners and subject-matter experts provide the content and contribute to the actual writing of bids. Some colleagues will be specifically trained to participate regularly in tender processes, while others may have limited experience with public tenders. Your role is not to take over their writing. Instead, you ensure the team understands what is required, why it matters and when it needs to be delivered. You are therefore a project manager, strategist, quality gatekeeper and challenger at the same time. You are comfortable challenging an experienced consultant or partner when their contribution is not yet strong enough. You ask the right questions, keep the team focused on the agreed strategy and know how to create momentum without relying on formal authority. Strong stakeholder management is therefore essential. You need to be able to lead complex projects and influence senior stakeholders, partners and consultants across the organisation. Building the Tender Desk In addition to managing individual bids, you will have another important responsibility: further professionalising Tender Management within Valcon. A foun

jobs.description: Wat ga je doen? Bij Cardiologie Centra Nederland, locatie Dokkum draai je zelfstandig spreekuur en ben je medisch inhoudelijk verantwoordelijk voor je eigen patiëntenpopulatie. Je stelt zelfstandig diagnose- en behandelplannen op, verricht risicostratificatie en begeleidt patiënten met uiteenlopende, complexe cardiologische beelden, zoals: Pijn op de borst (angina pectoris) en ischemische hartziekten; Hartritmestoornissen (o.a. atriumfibrilleren); Hartfalen, hypertensie en hypercholesterolemie; Hartkleplijden. Je komt te werken in een toegankelijk en informeel team, waarin we echt voor elkaar klaarstaan. Mocht jij jouw werk bijvoorbeeld op de cardiologie willen afwisselen met ervaring binnen bijvoorbeeld de traumatologie. Dan is dit zeker bespreekbaar na de opstart van deze nieuwe rol binnen onze poli cardiologie. Over ons: onze zorg klopt! We zijn een organisatie van zelfstandige behandelcentra voor hart- en vaatziekten die zich onderscheidt door poliklinische zorg perfect af te stemmen op de behoeften van de patiënt en de verwijzer. We geloven in de kracht van complete zorg onder één dak. Onze patiënten kunnen dicht bij huis terecht voor de meest hoogwaardige cardiologische zorg, en jij speelt daarin een belangrijke rol. Met een eigen PM-technicus én een eigen spoedpolikliniek in huis is de dynamiek hoog. Daarnaast beschikken we binnenkort over onze eigen CT coronairen. Je hebt de Master Physician Assistant (MPA) óf Master Advanced Nursing Practice (MANP) afgerond en beschikt over een geldige BIG-registratie; Je hebt aantoonbare klinische ervaring binnen de cardiologie (of een zeer sterke affiniteit om je hier in te verdiepen); Je bent communicatief sterk, werkt graag autonoom en zoekt de samenwerking op. De CAO zorgt voor een aantrekkelijk pakket aan arbeidsvoorwaarden. We willen het beste voor jou, het team en de patiënt. Wij bieden je onder andere het volgende: Een salaris tussen €5.295,- tot €7.901,- conform FWG 65 (cao ZKN) o.b.v. 40 uur per week. We schalen je in op basis van jouw ervaring; Vakantiegeld (8,33%), een eindejaarsuitkering van 8,33% en deelname aan de pensioenregeling bij PFZW; Een jaarcontract voor 16-32 uur per week, met duidelijke intentie op een volgend contract voor onbepaalde tijd; Een gezonde werk-privébalans: wij bieden uitsluitend regelmaat. Je draait dus géén diensten in de weekenden of avond/nacht; 160 uur vakantieverlof en 72 PLB-uren o.b.v. een fulltime dienstverband; Reiskostenvergoeding van €0,23/km (er zijn parkeermogelijkheden bij deze locatie) of een NS business card voor woon-werkverkeer; Vakinhoudelijke en professionele ontwikkeling met onze interne klinische lessen en andere opleidingsmogelijkheden. Tegelijkertijd worden we inmiddels ook steeds vaker gevraagd om vakmensen te begeleiden in (loopbaan)-coaching trajecten en bij gespreksbegeleiding. En die beweging naar preventieve dienstverlening omtrent de inzetbaarheid van vakmensen is precies de stap die ze de komende tijd samen met jou willen zetten. Jij zet vervolgens dat wat iemand wil, drijft en kan, om naar concrete acties om de inzetbaarheid van deze vakmensen te vergroten en behouden. Hierbij houd je rekening met de actuele regels tot Wet Verbetering Poortwachter en de verzuimcyclus van het UWV. Daarnaast ondersteun je de leidinggevenden van de verschillende ADG bedrijven hoe zij samen met hen de regie van vakmensen op het (werkende) leven naar de praktijk kunnen brengen. Vakmensen die werk doen wat vaak niet gezien wordt, juist als het écht goed gedaan wordt. Schoonmaakmedewerkers, onderhoudsmonteurs, hospitality professionals, BOA’s en zorgmedewerkers. Zij houden Nederland draaiend. Zij doen het voor hén. Jij blijft je, ook bij weerstand of uitdagingen, inspannen om de inzetbaarheid van vakmensen te vergroten of behouden. Je werkt precies en zorgvuldig en signaleert bij onvolledigheden en afwijkingen in de begeleiding of rapportages. jobs.title: Marketing & Content Intern (Haarlem)
jobs.description: Six restaurants. Six dishes. One afternoon, every dish with a pairing to match. An introduction to a city's food scene, and to the people shaping it. We have been making those introductions in the Netherlands as WijnSpijs since 2013. Table6 carries the same standards into the UK and Germany. The Netherlands is where we started and it is still the market we know best. Keeping it that way takes a steady stream of content: Dutch restaurants and creators to find and contact, footage and photography to collect and label, stories filmed on event days, posts prepared and checked after they go out. We are looking for a Marketing & Content Intern to work on all of it with us. The briefs, templates and guidelines already exist, so you are never starting from a blank page. You will use them from week one and take on more of the work yourself as you go. Most of what you do will be in Dutch. You will report to our Marketing Lead. The internship is hybrid, with agreed office days in Haarlem. Tasks Research restaurants, creators, photographers and videographers, and build shortlists against the criteria the marketing team gives you. Contact them, ask for footage, and follow up until it arrives. Come to selected events, including some Sundays, and film dishes, pairings, guest moments and the walk between restaurants to a short brief. Upload, name and label everything in Notion and Google Drive, so an editor can find it without asking you. Watch what our restaurant partners post, respond where it makes sense, and flag anything the marketing team should see. Prepare approved posts for scheduling, with captions, tags, links and locations, and check afterwards that they went out properly. In your first weeks you and your Marketing Lead agree what you want out of the internship and what you will own by the end of it. Requirements Fluent Dutch and strong English, written and spoken. jobs.title: Engineering Manager
jobs.description: Sunday creates pocket-sized friends for the mass market. We turn idle moments into meaningful connections for millions of users worldwide. Sunday focuses on the psychology of care, companionship, and empathy. We build accessible worlds where players don't just solve puzzles, they rescue friends. By combining mass-market accessibility with deep emotional hooks, we are defining the next era of digital entertainment. As Engineering Manager, you will lead Sunday's engineering team of approximately ten engineers across Unity game development and SDK. The position reports to the Director of Operations and works in close partnership with Production, Product, and Growth. The role combines people leadership with technical ownership. Your primary responsibility is to lead and develop the team and to define how engineering operates. At the same time, you remain close enough to the code to own architectural decisions, review critical work and contribute directly where this supports delivery. Our team delivers frequent releases across a portfolio of live games. We are looking for a leader who understands the trade-offs between quality, time and budget in the context of business priorities, and who translates them into sound technical decisions and the management of the team. This includes making our delivery pace sustainable through stable releases, a well-maintained codebase and engineering practices that scale with the business. The role carries a clear mandate to shape how engineering works at Sunday. What you will own People leadership: development plans, performance conversations against clear role expectations, hiring and onboarding. You hold conversations early and directly. Engineering ways of working: code review standards, quality gates before release, build and release pipeline, and a deliberate plan to reduce hotfixes and technical debt. Architecture and platform: owning the technical foundations shared across our games, including our in house SDK, analytics tracking, live configuration and the setup of A/B tests. Delivery partnership: working with the producers who lead our cross functional game teams on estimates, capacity and technical risk, and having the final say on whether a release is technically ready to ship. Transparency: making engineering progress, quality and capacity visible to the rest of the company through clear, measurable indicators. What you bring At least four years managing an engineering team of five or more people, including performance management and hiring. A strong engineering background of your own, ideally in C#, Unity or mobile development, so you can lead architecture and review decisions with credibility. A proven track record of success in a commercially driven company operating live products with real users, where engineering decisions are made against business priorities. A track record of raising quality and delivery predictability in a small or fast moving company, with concrete examples of what you changed and how you measured it. Comfort with direct conversations and with holding people to clear standards: Open, respectful, goal orientated. A pragmatic, data driven approach: you decide based on what the numbers show, and you introduce the process only where it pays back. Strong plus Experience in frequent shipping of mobile games, ideally free to play, casual or hybrid casual titles. Hands on knowledge of ad monetisation and mediation SDKs, mobile measurement partners and A/B testing infrastructure. Experience introducing CI/CD, automated testing or release quality gates in a game studio. Fuel for the Journey: Benefits to Support Your Ambitions Invest in Your Future : Regular feedback and our development program support your growth, helping you expand your skill set and achieve your career goals. Easy Arrival to Sunday : From signing to settling in Hamburg, we’ve got you covered. Need a visa? No problem. Ready to build your new life and career at applike in Hamburg? We support every ambit

jobs.title: Senior DevOps Engineer (all genders)
jobs.description: Sunday Natural is one of Germany’s fastest-growing natural health brands, and our eCommerce platform is growing with it – today it serves 7 million monthly active users , runs on €400k of AWS per year , and supports a development organization of 30+ engineers . Every one of those numbers has moved sharply upward in the last few years, and all of them will keep moving. You would be our first dedicated in-house Senior DevOps Engineer – and the two biggest engineering projects of the next two years are yours to help define and drive: bringing our entire infrastructure under Terraform, and strengthening the scalability, security and compliance posture across our cloud environments. Your role You shape the infrastructure vision. How we run, deploy, monitor and scale is yours to define, propose and defend. You work alongside our two external partners as the in-house technical counterpart – building the architecture and standards together, and bringing the deep platform knowledge back into the company. As the platform grows, taking the technical direction of that group is a natural next step, and one we would actively support. You own our AWS spend – €400k a year that currently has no dedicated owner, including where it goes and how we bring it down. You are the escalation point. When production is at risk, you decide. You report directly to the Head of eCommerce Platforms , with direct access to leadership for the decisions that need it. What you'll own AWS infrastructure – EC2, RDS, Fargate, CloudFront, S3, IAM – plus Cloudflare, DNS and WAF Security & compliance – DevSecOps practices, system audits, patching and access reviews, and GDPR-compliant data handling across every environment Infrastructure as code – taking us from manually managed to fully Terraform-defined Data layer – MySQL under production load: tuning, replication, and backups you have actually restored from Cloud economics – a €350k annual AWS budget with real headroom for optimisation Delivery for 30+ developers – Bitbucket Pipelines, environments, and how fast and safely code reaches production Reliability at 7M MAU – monitoring, logging, alerting and incident response (New Relic, Sentry, CloudWatch, PagerDuty) Your profile 7+ years running production infrastructure , with deep hands-on AWS as the person accountable when it breaks Security-conscious infrastructure operations – DevSecOps practices, system audits and access reviews, comfortable being jobs.title: Automotive MCU Chip Architect

The successful candidate will work closely with product management, safety, security, design, verification, software, and implementation teams to ensure the MCU architecture meets demanding automotive requirements for real-time performance, functional safety, cybersecurity, reliability, scalability, and cost efficiency. What you'll do Key Responsibilities System Architecture Definition Define the overall automotive MCU architecture from product, customer, and market requirements. Translate use cases into chip-level requirements covering performance, safety, security, power, cost, and scalability. Drive system partitioning across CPUs, memories, interconnects, peripherals, safety/security functions, debug, test, and power domains. Own architecture trade-offs and document decision rationale for reuse across MCU families and derivatives. Subsystem Architecture Ownership Align subsystem concepts and interfaces across compute, memory, bus/interconnect, peripheral, safety, security, power/reset/clock, debug/trace, and DFT/test domains. Ensure subsystem requirements are implementation-feasible and verifiable at RTL, subsystem, chip, silicon, and software levels. Define hardware/software-visible architecture elements such as memory maps, register model principles, interrupts, DMA, boot flow, and access-control concepts. Cross-Functional Technical Leadership Lead architecture reviews and resolve trade-offs between product management, system engineering, safety, security, design, verification, software, backend, test, and validation teams. Provide technical guidance during concept, design, verification, silicon bring-up, qualification, and customer support phases. Ensure architectural consistency, requirement traceability, and risk closure across global engineering teams. What we require Required Technical Expertise MCU / SoC Architecture Deep understanding of real-time MCU architectures, CPU subsystems, memories, peripheral integration, low-power design, product-family scalability, and silicon implementation constraints. Automotive Functional Safety Practical ISO 26262 expertise including ASIL concepts, safety goals, technical safety requirements, FMEDA/DFA/FTA awareness, and definition of safety mechanisms at system and subsystem level. Automotive Cybersecurity Understanding of secure boot, hardware root of trust, HSM integration, cryptographic accelerators, key management, lifecycle states, secure debug, and ISO/SAE 21434 concepts. Digital Design and Implementation Awareness Ability to reason about RTL feasibility, timing, area, power, DFT, backend constraints, IP integration, verification closure, and bring-up observability. Embedded Software Awareness Working knowledge of startup software, boot flows, drivers, AUTOSAR concepts, RTOS use, interrupts, memory protection, debug, and software-visible register behavior. jobs.description: Chief Science Officer @ Sereact 🦾 Chief Science Officer (m/f/d) · Zurich or Stuttgart, Boston possible · Reports to the CEO · Full-time Who we are Sereact builds the robot brain for physical work. Cortex , our vision-language-action foundation model, is hardware-agnostic: the same model runs single-arm and dual-arm systems, mobile manipulators and humanoids that pick, sort and handle returns in live production across Europe and the US. Customers include Zalando, IKEA, BMW, Rohlik and DHL. Founded in 2021 in Stuttgart, with an R&D hub in Zurich and a US office in Boston. We have raised more than $145 million, most recently a $116 million Series B led by Headline, with Zalando as a strategic investor. We work in small, senior teams with a flat structure; execution counts more than titles. Why this role, why now Our robots produce data no lab can stage. Our fleet has recorded more than 500 million manipulation interactions in live warehouse operations; Cortex 2.0 was trained on a curated 10 million of them and added a world model that plans before it acts ( arXiv 2604.20246 ). Cortex 2.5 learns a new task from a few demonstrations instead of a training run. Deployments are growing from single robots to fleets, and the research team is growing with them. We now want one scientific leader who owns the research behind Cortex end to end and turns what our fleet experiences every day into the next step change in what robots can do. The Real-World Learning Loop is your system Sereact is a frontier research lab and a production-grade robotics company in one. Our bet: general-purpose robotic intelligence “must be learned from live deployments” ( The Real-World Learning Loop , Feb 2026). Every stage of that loop is yours to raise: In-Situ Policy Execution. Every robot in production runs the current policy, and every shift is an experiment. You decide what the policies expose for learning. Continuous Data Acquisition. Robots annotate their own interactions while they work. You decide what is worth recording and which situations the fleet should go and find. Data Curation and Learning. Novelty, uncertainty, failures and distribution shift decide what we learn from. You own the curation and the training recipe. Evaluation and Policy Redeployment. Updated policies pass validation gates before they return to the fleet. You set the bar, and how fast we can clear it safely. Every deployment teaches the next one. Your job is to make that loop turn faster and teach more each time. Responsibilities Set the research agenda for Cortex: vision-language-action models, world models and planning, learning from interaction on real robots, and generalization across tasks and embodiments. Make the big bets: which directions get people and compute, and which ones we stop. Own the data strategy: the mix of deployment, teleoperation, open-source and synthetic data, and what the fleet collects next. Own the compute strategy, from large-scale training to real-time inference on the robot. Build the evaluation science: benchmarks that predict performance in a customer’s operation, not only on a leaderboard. Build and lead the research organisation in Zurich and Stuttgart: structure, leads, rhythm. Set the hiring bar and make Sereact the place the best people in robot learning want to join. Take research into production with engineering, so results reach the fleet in weeks and hold up in 24/7 operation. Decide with the founders what we publish, open-source or patent, and build our standing at CoRL, RSS, ICRA, NeurIPS and ICML. Be Sereact’s scientific voice with customers, partners, universities and investors, and build academic partnerships. Partner with the CTO, product and operations, so research, engineering and deployment pull in one direction. Not in scope, by design Software platform, hardware and field deployment engineering. raise the technical bar through design reviews rather than rework.</li> <li>Partner with DSP, software, mechanical, and systems engineering, and with regulatory/compliance on CE, FCC, and MIL-STD qualification.</li> <li>Advise leadership on technology direction, build-vs-buy, and technical risk.</li> </ul> <h3>What You Bring</h3> <ul> <li>10+ years in RF hardware design, with a track record of products shipped to volume.</li> <li>Deep expertise across VHF, UHF, and SHF — not just one band.</li> <li>Demonstrated design ownership of mixers and high-power amplifiers above 10 W.</li> <li>Strong command of RF simulation tooling — EM and circuit solvers (e.g. ADS, AWR, HFSS, CST) — and the judgment to know when simulation is telling you the truth.</li> <li>Multi-layer RF PCB design: controlled impedance, material selection, grounding, isolation, thermal management.</li> <li>Fluent with VNAs, spectrum analyzers, signal generators, and power measurement; jobs.description: We are looking for a Composite Development Engineer to build the material foundation of our rocket structures and generate material data that design and analysis can trust. Select composite material systems and qualify suitable manufacturing processes. Validate material properties on manufactured components and feed results back into design and analysis. Help develop the materials laboratory, including procedures, safety practices, equipment capability, and material-handling standards. A methodical approach to experimental work, measurement, documentation, and data quality. Fluent English and the ability to communicate technical results clearly. Laboratory equipment such as DSC, DMA, tensile-test systems, microscopy, or similar materials-characterisation equipment. Working proficiency in German. jobs.description: Senior Data Scientist - Credit Risk Modelling Hybrid in London or remote in the UK We’re looking for a Senior Data Scientist to join our Credit Risk Modelling team. You'll shape how iwoca models credit risk – setting the technical direction on multi-quarter projects, and lifting the bar for the team as you go. The company Small businesses move fast. Opportunities often don’t wait, and cash flow pressures can appear overnight. To keep going, and growing, SMEs need finance that’s as flexible and responsive as they are. That's why we built iwoca. Our smart technology, data science and five-star customer service ensures business owners can act with the speed, confidence and control they need, exactly when it's needed. We’ve already cleared the way for 100,000 businesses with more than £4 billion in funding. Our passionate team is driven to help even more SMEs succeed, through access to better finance and other services that make running a business easier. Our ultimate mission is to support one million SMEs in their defining moments, creating lasting impact for the communities and economies they drive. The team The Credit Risk Modelling team owns credit risk and Customer Lifetime Value (CLtV) modelling for iwoca's UK and German lending. That covers the probabilistic machine learning models behind every credit decision, plus the CLtV models that shape pricing and portfolio strategy. The team is around twelve data scientists. Some work on auto-space models that decide within five minutes from data candidates authorise us to pull. Others work on manual-space models that pick up when a credit analyst adds digital footprint and income data, which lands a decision within 24 hours. The role You'll own credit and CLtV modelling projects end to end, from spotting where the modelling stack is holding the business back through to landing the change. The work spans keeping production models healthy, incremental development, and research that reshapes how the models work. AI has lowered the cost of prototyping enough that ideas which used to sit below the priority line are now viable, so the R&D share of the role is growing. Live examples of the work: Causal estimation of offer terms. Modelling how amount, duration, and price shape customer outcomes. Unifying auto and manual models. The two families were built without forced technical alignment. Finding a principled way to unify them on a common cost function is open work. IFRS accounting model. A multi-stage credit model where information propagates back from later-stage recovery predictions to sharpen upfront loss estimates. Generalising credit and CLtV. Whether a more general framing could replace both separate models is an open research question. The requirements Essential: Communication. You write and speak clearly, directly, and concisely. You adapt technical detail to your audience. Statistical foundations. You have a background in probability and statistics from a quantitative field. You reason about uncertainty and calibration as first-order concerns. Production ML. You have built and shipped supervised ML models end to end – exploration, training, deployment, monitoring. Research mindset. You proactively explore new ways to add value. R&D time is when you expect to find the next step change. Judgement. You defend your reasoning under challenge, and challenge others' when the evidence points elsewhere. You've influenced technical direction beyond your own projects. Project leadership. You've owned modelling projects end to end, from spotting the opportunity through framing, method choice, shipping, and landing the commercial impact. You move fast, iterate, and update on new evidence rather than chase perfection. AI fluency. You use AI as a primary tool. You prototype with it, automate with it, and take on R&D that would not otherwise be viable. You use judgement

jobs.title: Responsable d'équipe commerciale – Télévente B2C
jobs.description: Rejoins une scale-up en pleine croissance ! Octopus Energy Services France (OESF) est la société sœur d' Octopus Energy France , fournisseur d'énergie verte qui accompagne déjà plus de 750 000 clients en France . Notre mission ? Accélérer la transition énergétique en équipant les particuliers de panneaux solaires, batteries de stockage et bornes de recharge. Lancée il y a seulement trois ans, OESF compte déjà plus de 50 collaborateurs et une équipe commerciale d'une vingtaine de personnes répartie entre Paris et Lille. Et ce n'est que le début ! Nous sommes en pleine phase de scale-up avec de fortes ambitions de croissance. Pour accompagner cette accélération, nous recherchons notre futur(e) Sales Team Leader pour piloter notre équipe commerciale à Paris !   Ta mission : emmener ton équipe vers la performance ! Tu prends la responsabilité d'une équipe de 7 Business Developers sédentaires qui commercialisent nos solutions par téléphone et visioconférence, du premier contact jusqu'à la signature. Ton objectif ? Fédérer ton équipe, faire progresser chaque commercial(e) et atteindre les objectifs de ventes ! Tu es un·e manager de proximité qui allie coaching, exigence et bienveillance. Tu travailleras en étroite collaboration avec le Sales Team Leader de Lille, les technico-commerciaux terrain et notre Bureau d'Études.   Tes missions seront les suivantes :  Management et animation d'équipe : Motiver et accompagner ton équipe grâce à des coachings réguliers et des feedbacks constructifs. Animer les réunions commerciales, organiser des challenges et créer une véritable émulation collective au quotidien. Porter les projets de l'entreprise auprès de ton équipe. Participer au recrutement, à l'intégration et à la formation des nouvelles recrues. Pilotage de la performance commerciale : Être responsable de l'atteinte des objectifs individuels et collectifs de ton équipe en pilotant les KPI commerciaux (CA, taux de conversion, nombre d’appels, etc.). Garantir la bonne application des processus commerciaux et la qualité du suivi client. Identifier les difficultés et mettre en place des plans d'action pour améliorer les résultats. Montrer l'exemple en participant ponctuellement à des appels, des visios et des closings. Le profil qu'on recherche : Avant tout, un vrai tempérament commercial , le goût de la performance et l'envie de faire progresser les autres ! Tu as une première expérience réussie en management d'équipe commerciale en télévente B2C ou B2B , par téléphone et/ou visioconférence. Tu maîtrises les techniques de vente , de négociation et de closing et tu sais transmettre ton savoir-faire. Tu es un·e coach dans l'âme. Tu sais fédérer et motiver une équipe. Tu allies énergie positive, exigence, autonomie et rigueur au quotidien. Pas besoin de connaître le solaire sur le bout des doigts ! Ce qui compte, c'est ton expérience commerciale, tes qualités managériales et ton état d'esprit. Pourquoi nous rejoindre ? Une équipe qui a de l'énergie : une ambiance dynamique, de l'entraide, des challenges et le plaisir de célébrer les victoires ensemble. Une entreprise en pleine croissance : une aventure entrepreneuriale où chacun a un rôle à jouer et où les résultats se voient concrètement. Des produits qui ont du sens : des solutions concrètes pour aider nos clients à maîtriser leur énergie tout en accélérant la transition énergétique. Des locaux incroyables : des bureaux modernes, un superbe open space et un cadre de travail qui donne envie de venir chaque matin ! Télétravail : jusqu'à 2 jours par semaine. Prêt(e) à relever le défi ? jobs.title: People Operations Specialist (data & projects) H/F
jobs.description: Tu as envie de travailler dans un environnement bienveillant qui avance vite ? 5ème fournisseur français en 10 ans, Octopus Energy est un fournisseur d’énergies renouvelables qui agit comme un véritable fer de lance pour la révolution électro tech.   Comment on fait ?  On ne peut pas révolutionner le monde en travaillant comme tout le monde On essaye de ne pas trop se prendre la tête, ici on évolue dans un environnement sans trop de process ni trop de règles. Le plus important, ce n’est pas seulement de suivre le mouvement, mais de le créer. On ne veut pas créer des clones d’entreprise. On te veut toi, avec tes talents, tes perspectives et tes compétences uniques. Tu as envie de rejoindre une entreprise qui grandit vite, avec beaucoup d’autonomie et une façon assez différente de faire les People Ops ? Bienvenue chez Octopus Energy France. Chez nous, nous fonctionnons selon un modèle NoHR : les managers sont le premier point de contact people de leurs équipes. Le rôle de l’équipe People Ops est de leur donner le bon cadre, les bons outils, les bonnes informations et les bons réflexes pour qu’ils puissent être autonomes au quotidien. Dans ce contexte, nous cherchons aujourd’hui quelqu’un de solide en People Ops , capable à la fois de construire et faire évoluer nos façons de travailler , mais aussi de contribuer concrètement au quotidien de l’équipe . Le poste est organisé autour de deux grands volets, qui représentent chacun environ 50 % du rôle : du build : projets People, outils, data, automatisation, IA, amélioration de nos process du run : administration du personnel, paie, support aux managers et aux équipes, contrôle et fiabilisation des données Cet équilibre n’est évidemment pas figé : selon les actualités, les projets ou les périodes de l’année, tu pourras passer davantage de temps sur l’un ou l’autre. Ce qu’on cherche surtout, c’est quelqu’un qui aime construire des choses sans perdre le contact avec l’opérationnel . Ce que tu fera : 1. Build : faire évoluer nos People Ops Une partie importante de ton rôle sera de prendre en main des projets qui permettent à l’équipe People Ops et aux managers de travailler mieux, plus simplement et plus efficacement. Tu pourras notamment : piloter des projets People de bout en bout, de l’identification du besoin jusqu’à la mise en œuvre simplifier et améliorer nos process construire et faire évoluer notre Help Hub et notre documentation construire des dashboards et des reportings utiles au pilotage : consolider et mieux exploiter les données issues de nos différents outils automatiser certains contrôles, reportings ou tâches répétitives identifier et tester des cas d’usage simples autour de l’IA et de l’automatisation participer à des projets Groupe avec les équipes Octopus basées notamment au Royaume-Uni accompagner les managers dans l’adoption de nouveaux outils ou de nouvelles façons de travailler On cherche quelqu’un qui aime partir d’un besoin parfois encore un peu flou, le comprendre, le structurer et arriver à une solution concrète. La data et l’IA sont des outils au service des People Ops et des équipes , pas une fin en soi. Nous ne cherchons donc ni un·e Data Analyst pur, ni un profil tech, mais quelqu’un qui sait s’en servir pour résoudre des problèmes opérationnels. 2. Run : contribuer au quotidien de l’équipe L’autre moitié du poste consiste à être pleinement partie prenante des People Ops du quotidien. Selon les besoins de l’équipe, tu pourras intervenir sur : l’administration du personnel : contrats, avenants, mouvements, absences, sorties… la préparation et le contrôle de la paie le contrôle et la cohérence des données entre nos différents outils les questions des managers et des salarié·es le suivi et la résolution de sujets opérationnels le support à l’équipe lors des périodes de forte activité ou lorsqu’un sujet urgent apparaît L’idée n’est pas de te spécialiser dans l’administration ou la paie. En revanche, tu dois être à l’aise pour mettre les mains dedan

jobs.title: Growth & AI Marketing Operations Specialist
jobs.description: About Papers Papers AG is a Swiss cyber security engineering house and an incubator for our product portfolio. We build device-level alternatives to centralized cloud and trust. Our strategy is to grow our foundational decentralized network by building high-demand enterprise products directly on top of it. Your portfolio includes: Acurast: Decentralized confidential compute running on ordinary smartphones. Obsidio: A continuous, AI-assisted pentesting subscription. Incubated by Papers, Obsidio is built directly on Acurast, leveraging the decentralized network as a unique compute moat to battle-test networks. Hypergate: Enterprise mobile single sign-on for managed Android and iOS fleets. As an engineering-driven team, we work with autonomy and purpose. Our culture is built on meritocracy, long-term thinking, and a commitment to quality over buzz, innovation is in our DNA. We aim to collaborate with people who love tech for its own sake and want to help shape the future by solving real-world challenges. Your role We are seeking a tech-savvy, execution-oriented Growth & AI Marketing Operations Specialist to serve as the engine powering our growth campaigns, content infrastructure, and data analytics pipeline. Your main goal will be to communicate our stories across a portfolio of brands by bridging the gap between cutting-edge AI, data operations, and tactical growth marketing. You’ll be building automated content workflows, ensuring the highest quality across everything we generate, running multi-channel campaigns from start to finish, and maintaining rock-solid attribution tracking. If you are obsessed with efficiency, operational speed, and using AI to scale output without ever sacrificing quality and if you thrive when given a blank slate to write your own playbook, this role is for you. Success Metrics (First 90 Days) 30 Days: Take full ownership of the existing marketing tech stack and establish baseline performance metrics. 60 Days: Fully automate the core content generation pipeline and establish QA workflows. 90 Days: Launch at least two multi-channel growth experiments and demonstrate a measurable reduction in CAC or an increase in content throughput. Core Responsibilities 1. Storytelling That Converts Making Complexity Clear: Take complex, often highly technical capabilities and features and turn them into clear, digestible stories without losing accuracy. Audience-First Messaging: Understand who the campaigns speak to (developers, technical decision-makers, business stakeholders or end users) and frame each capability around what that audience cares about, at the right level of technical depth. Spark Curiosity & Action: Craft narratives that get audiences interested and excited, and that move them to the desired conversion. Product & Engineering Collaboration: Work closely with product and engineering teams to deeply understand what is being built, so every story is both compelling and technically correct. 2. Tactical Deployment & Agile Execution Multi-Channel Campaign Launch: Execute and launch integrated campaigns across communities, social channels, search, newsletters, loyalty programs, influencers, paid ads and landing pages. Where needed, bring in and coordinate additional third parties to support execution, such as external PR firms and campaign support providers. Marketing Automation: Maintain and scale lifecycle workflows, lead scoring mechanisms, drip sequences, and automated triggers to optimize lead conversion through the relevant funnel. Rapid A/B & Multivariate Testing: Design, set up, and evaluate rapid growth experiments (copy variants, landing page layouts, audience segmentation, offer positioning) on a weekly sprint cycle. 3. AI Pipeline Operation & Content QA Automated Workflow Orchestration: Build, maintain, and optimize AI-driven content pipelines to generate high-quality marketing assets at scale. Human-in-the-Loop Quality Assurance: Establish strict QA processes to review, refine, and approve AI

Wir verbinden Chips mit Computernetzwerken mit hohem Durchsatz und geringer Verzögerung. Der Schlüssel liegt in der Nutzung der physikalischen Eigenschaften von Graphen, um elektronische Datenverarbeitung mit photonischer Kommunikation zu verbinden, so dass zahllose Chips miteinander interagieren können, als wären sie ein einziger. Unsere Graphen-Photonik-Innovation steigert die Rechenleistung und Effizienz in einer neuen Größenordnung. Du stellst die Versorgungssicherheit sicher, optimierst die Gesamtkosten über den gesamten Beschaffungslebenszyklus hinweg und gewährleistest die Einhaltung der Qualitätsanforderungen. Dabei berücksichtigst du sowohl die sich stets weiterentwickelnden technologischen Anforderungen als auch die Veränderungen der Marktbedingungen. Beim Verhandeln von Verträgen, Preisen und sonstigen Konditionen hast du unsere Kostenziele immer im Blick und sicherst gleichzeitig eine verlässliche Belieferung. Darüber hinaus beobachtest du kontinuierlich die Märkte für Halbleitermaterialien, die Leistung der Lieferanten, Preistrends sowie Risiken in der Lieferkette, um Chancen frühzeitig zu erkennen und gezielte Maßnahmen zur Risikominderung zu entwickeln. In enger Zusammenarbeit mit den Teams aus R&D, Process Engineering, Qualitätssicherung und Fertigung stimmst du die Materialbeschaffung bestmöglich auf die technologischen Vorgaben und Produktionsanforderungen ab. Bei der Einführung neuer Produkte unterstützt du tatkräftig, indem du Materialien beschaffst, die den neuen Prozessanforderungen und Skalierungszielen gerecht werden. Mit Buchhaltung und Teamleitern zusammenarbeiten; die operative Abwesenheitsverwaltung bleibt bei den Teamleitern. Recruiting – regional und mit Blick auf nachhaltige Einstellungen Geeignete Mitarbeitende insbesondere für gewerbliche und operative Tätigkeiten am Standort Heiligenhaus und in der Umgebung gewinnen. Recruiting über JOIN, Indeed, StepStone und unser Programm „Mitarbeiter werben Mitarbeiter“ organisieren und optimieren. Bewerbungen sichten, Kandidatinnen und Kandidaten vorqualifizieren und Vorstellungsgespräche gemeinsam mit den Teamleitern führen. Nicht nur schnell offene Stellen besetzen, sondern sorgfältig auswählen, damit Menschen fachlich und persönlich langfristig zu uns passen. Mit der Geschäftsführung und den Führungskräften Anforderungen und Auswahlkriterien weiterentwickeln. Digitalisierung und KI Bestehende Abläufe kritisch hinterfragen und die begonnene Professionalisierung unserer Personalarbeit fortsetzen. Unsere webbasierte Personalverwaltung nutzen und Verbesserungen anstoßen; ältere Systeme und Medienbrüche pragmatisch berücksichtigen. Digitale Workflows und sinnvolle Automatisierung für Administration und Recruiting mitentwickeln. Offen mit KI-gestützten Hilfsmitteln experimentieren, beispielsweise bei der strukturierten Aufbereitung von Bewerbungen – mit Datenschutz, nachvollziehbaren Kriterien und menschlicher Entscheidung über Bewerbende.
