Praktische Erfahrung in operativer Personalarbeit und Recruiting; zwei bis drei Jahre können ausreichen, wenn du bereits eigenständig Verantwortung getragen hast. Fundierte Kenntnisse des Arbeitsrechts und Sicherheit bei der Vorbereitung und Einschätzung arbeitsrechtlicher Vorgänge. Idealerweise Erfahrung mit Personalstrukturen mittlerer Größe und/oder gewerblichen Mitarbeitenden. Gute Menschenkenntnis, sorgfältige Bewerberauswahl und klare, verständliche Kommunikation. Selbstständigkeit, Organisationstalent, Diskretion und die Fähigkeit, auch im turbulenten Alltag den Überblick zu behalten. Interesse an digitalen Werkzeugen, Prozessverbesserung und KI. Du musst noch keinen kompletten Personalbereich allein geleitet haben. Wichtiger ist, dass du schon Verantwortung übernommen hast und bereit bist, den Bereich bei uns eigenständig zu führen. Das bieten wir dir Unbefristete Festanstellung mit sechs Monaten Probezeit. 30 bis 40 Wochenstunden; Vollzeit ist willkommen. Arbeit überwiegend in Heiligenhaus; nach der Einarbeitung Homeoffice nach Absprache möglich. Eigenständige Verantwortung für deinen Bereich und unmittelbare Zusammenarbeit mit der Geschäftsführung und unseren Teamleitern. Kurze Wege, unkomplizierte Kommunikation und die Möglichkeit, bestehende Abläufe aktiv zu verbessern.

jobs.title: IT-Generalist (m/w/d) – Linux, IT-Support & Digitalisierung
jobs.description: Du arbeitest gerne mit Linux, löst technische Probleme und möchtest IT aktiv modernisieren? Die PST Gruppe in Heiligenhaus ist ein Dienstleistungsunternehmen im Bereich Reparatur, Aufbereitung und Logistik technischer Geräte. Mit rund 85 Mitarbeitenden sorgen wir täglich dafür, dass Technik wieder funktioniert und Geräte möglichst lange genutzt werden können. Auch unsere eigene IT möchten wir weiterentwickeln: weg von historisch gewachsenen Strukturen, hin zu einer modernen, schlanken und zuverlässigen IT-Landschaft. Dabei setzen wir künftig verstärkt auf Linux, Open-Source-Lösungen, Digitalisierung und intelligente Automatisierung. Dafür suchen wir jemanden, der nicht nur IT-Probleme löst, sondern auch mitdenkt, bestehende Lösungen hinterfragt und Veränderungen aktiv mitgestaltet. Deine Aufgaben IT-Support und Anwenderbetreuung Zentrale Ansprechperson für unsere Mitarbeitenden bei technischen Fragen und Problemen sein. Arbeitsplatzrechner, Drucker, Labeldrucker, Handscanner, Tablets und weitere IT-Geräte betreuen. Arbeitsplätze einrichten, Software installieren sowie Benutzerkonten und Zugriffsrechte verwalten. Störungen analysieren und pragmatische, nachhaltige Lösungen finden. Systemadministration und Infrastruktur Unsere bestehende IT-Infrastruktur mit lokalen Servern, Netzwerken und Arbeitsplatzrechnern betreuen. Grundlegende Administrationsaufgaben übernehmen, etwa bei Netzwerkdiensten und virtuellen Maschinen. Für regelmäßige Sicherheitsupdates, Systempflege und die Kontrolle vorhandener Backup-Prozesse sorgen. Bei komplexeren Aufgaben mit externen IT-Dienstleistern und Sicherheitsspezialisten zusammenarbeiten. Linux und Modernisierung Die geplante Umstellung von Windows auf Linux auf Arbeitsplätzen und in Teilen der Serverlandschaft aktiv begleiten. Kenntnisse in Linux-Distributionen wie Linux Mint oder Ubuntu einbringen. Geeignete Open-Source-Lösungen auswählen, einrichten und deren Einführung unterstützen. Vorschläge entwickeln, wie sich unsere IT vereinfachen, standardisieren und wirtschaftlicher betreiben lässt. Digitalisierung und Weiterentwicklung Bestehende Abläufe hinterfragen und Möglichkeiten zur Digitalisierung und Automatisierung erkennen. Gemeinsam mit der Geschäftsführung moderne Arbeitsplatzkonzepte entwickeln, etwa mit einem sinnvolleren Einsatz von Tablets, Smartphones und zentralen Kommunikationslösungen. Technische Optionen verständlich erklären und bei IT-Entscheidungen beraten. Interne Entwickler und externe Dienstleister fachlich koordinieren, ohne selbst Software entwickeln zu müssen. Das bringst du mit Gute praktische Linux-Kenntnisse, besonders bei Desktop-Distributionen wie Linux Mint, Ubuntu oder vergleichbaren Systemen. Erfahrung im Anwendersupport und Umgang mit PCs, Druckern, Scannern und anderen Endgeräten. Grundkenntnisse in Netzwerk, Systemadministration und operativer IT-Sicherheit. Ausreichende Windows-Kenntnisse, um die bestehende Umgebung zu betreuen und die spätere Migration zu begleiten – du musst kein Windows-Spezialist sein. Eine IT-Ausbildung oder vergleichbare, nachweisbare praktische Erfahrung; qualifizierte Quereinsteiger sind willkommen. Selbstständige, strukturierte Arbeitsweise und die Fähigkeit, Technik auch für Nicht-IT-Fachleute verständlich zu erklären. Besonders wichtig ist uns deine Einstellung: Du wartest nicht nur auf die nächste Störungsmeldung, sondern erkennst Verbesserungspotenziale und machst Dinge einfacher und besser. Du weißt auch, wann externe Spezialisten gebraucht werden. Das bieten wir dir Unbefristete Anstellung mit sechs Monaten Probezeit. Teilzeit ca. 30 Wochenstunden Weitgehend eigenständige Betreuung der internen operativen IT. Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit der Geschäftsführung und viel Raum für eigene Ideen. Eine abwechslungsreiche technische Umgebung und die Chance, einen Linux- und Open-Source-orientierten Wandel mitzugestalten. Externe Unterstützung bei komplexen Infrastruktur- und Sicherheitsthemen. Überwiegend Tätigkeit am Standort Heiligenhaus

You will also oversee elements of the executive onboarding experience, in partnership with the People, Office, and IT teams. We’re also transforming business travel with a new corporate travel solution, KAYAK for Business ( K4B ). You will take end-to-end functional ownership for Business Ethics, Anti-Bribery & Corruption, Speak-up and Internal Investigations. This is a senior individual-contributor role with clear functional ownership and no direct people-management responsibility at present. As part of the integrated Governance, Risk & Compliance organization, you will work across Risk Governance, Ethics & Compliance, ESG and Group Assurance to help establish effective and scalable governance. You will independently develop, implement and manage the assigned programmes, frameworks and processes, translating the Group Integrity Framework into practical standards, controls and guidance. Working closely with relevant corporate functions, you will help prevent misconduct, respond credibly to potential violations and build a risk-based, scalable Compliance Management System for our growing international defense-technology business. Manage the Group Speak-up & Whistleblowing Framework , including reporting channels, intake, triage, confidentiality, non-retaliation safeguards, case routing and effectiveness monitoring. Lead sensitive and complex internal investigations and maintain the related case management framework , ensuring fair, objective, timely and confidential processes, robust investigation mandates, planning, interviews, evidence handling, documentation, escalation, reporting, data protection and retention. Advise management and coordinate with relevant functions , providing concise reporting on material cases, trends, risks and remediation. jobs.description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>Welcome to Planet. We believe in using space to help life on Earth.</strong></p> <p>Planet designs, builds, and operates the largest constellation of imaging satellites in history. This constellation delivers an unprecedented dataset of empirical information via a revolutionary cloud-based platform to authoritative figures in commercial, environmental, and humanitarian sectors. Unterstützt von Investoren wie der <em>Bill &amp; Melinda Gates Foundation</em> bauen wir gemeinsam das modernste, 100 % elektrische Liefersystem Europas.</p> <p><iframe src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/o1FOzeb4YYs" width="560" height="314"></iframe></p> <h2><strong>Das erwartet dich&nbsp;</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Teamleitung: </strong>Du bist Coach und Vorbild – mit deinem echten, intrinsischen Interesse an Menschen führst und inspirierst du dein Team aus 3 Teamleitenden und über 30 Lagermitarbeitenden.</li> <li><strong>Schichtleitung: </strong>Im FC behältst du stets den Überblick, priorisierst Aufgaben im Tagesgeschäft und sorgst dafür, dass jede Bestellung pünktlich rausgeht.</li> <li><strong>Abwechslung:</strong> Du erlebst den perfekten Mix aus Action direkt auf der Lagerfläche (3–4 Tage pro Woche) und strategischem Deep Dive im FC Office (1–2 Tage pro Woche).</li> <li><strong>Prozessoptimierung: </strong>Stillstand gibt es bei uns nicht. Du hast Ideen? Hier entwickelst du eigene Logistikprojekte und hebst unsere Abläufe durch deinen Tatendrang aufs nächste Level.</li> <li><strong>Ownership:</strong> Du hast Lust, Verantwortung zu übernehmen, auch wenn Dinge mal außerhalb deines unmittelbaren Bereichs liegen. Du schaust über den Tellerrand hinaus und nimmst die Dinge proaktiv selbst in die Hand.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Das bringst du mit</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Ein abgeschlossenes Studium (Bachelor oder Master) in Logistikmanagement, Supply Chain Management, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen oder einem vergleichbaren Bereich.</li> <li>Du brennst für die Logistik und bringst idealerweise erste Einblicke aus dem Lagerbereich mit (z. B. durch Praktika oder ein Werkstudium).</li> <li>Du kommunizierst sicher auf Deutsch &amp; Englisch und bringst die nötige Flexibilität für die Arbeit in zwei Schichten (6:00 – 14:30 Uhr &amp; 14:30 – 23:00 Uhr, auch samstags) mit.</li> <li>Ein extrem hohes Maß an Eigenantrieb. Du siehst Dinge von selbst, nimmst sie proaktiv in die Hand und übernimmst Verantwortung – auch über deinen eigenen Tellerrand hinaus.</li> <li>Ein echtes, intrinsisches Interesse an Menschen. Du bist empathisch, nahbar und liebst es, dein Team zu motivieren und weiterzuentwickeln.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Darauf kannst du dich freuen</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Starte durch - mit uns:</strong> Werde Teil unseres internationalen Teams in einem Umfeld, das echtes Wachstum und eine „Act like an Owner“-Mentalität fördert. Bei uns hast du die Chance, Projekte eigenverantwortlich voranzutreiben, neue Ideen zu testen und direkt miterleben zu können, wie deine Arbeit in unserem schnell wachsenden Unternehmen Wirkung zeigt.</li> <li><strong>Nachhaltigkeit als Kern:</strong> Werde Teil der Revolution. Du trägst zu einer grüneren Zukunft bei – durch unsere 100 % elektrische Flotte und eine Lieferkette, die Lebensmittelverschwendung reduziert.</li> <li><strong>Die Basics:</strong> Wir stellen dir alles für deinen Erfolg bereit – inklusive Laptop und Handy sowie Zugang zu exklusiven Mitarbeiter-Rabatten (Corporate Benefits) für Reisen, Technik und vieles mehr.</li&g

jobs.description: <p>Four models in production today. Fifteen to twenty by mid-2027. The shared pipeline that gets them there has to hold — and you own everything after handoff: packaging, deployment, drift detection, and the call on whether a model is fit to serve.</p> <p><strong>Location:</strong> Central Berlin — you work from our office, hybrid with 3 days office and 2 days home office.</p> <h3>&nbsp;</h3> <h3>About us</h3> <p>CarOnSale is the AI-powered platform for B2B used car trading in Europe. Over 40,000 buyers from more than 20 countries trade on our platform — and 85% of inventory is exclusive to us. We connect software, pricing intelligence, logistics and financing in one layer — as the operating system for an entire industry.</p> <p><em><strong>One Platform. One Profit Engine.</strong></em></p> <h3>&nbsp;</h3> <h3>The platform you build in</h3> <p>Our machine learning runs on one shared, central platform — not a separate pipeline per model. Five canonical stages: data extraction, validation, transformation, training and evaluation. A Snowflake data warehouse feeds a SageMaker managed feature store, and models reach production through governed CI/CD promotion lanes on Terraform-managed AWS infrastructure. Your job is to build inside it and make it stronger, so the next model costs less to ship than the last one.</p> <h3>&nbsp;</h3> <h3>Your responsibilities</h3> <ul> <li>You own models from handoff through to production: packaging, deployment, monitoring, and the decision on whether a model is ready to serve</li> <li>You keep production models reliable — drift detection, performance monitoring, alerting and incident response when something moves</li> <li>You own the serving and inference path: fitted pipeline artifacts, inference entry points, monitoring hooks and feature-store parity</li> <li>You review model design and evaluation methodology before anything ships, and catch data leakage, backward-window errors and weak evaluation during development, while they are still cheap to fix</li> <li>You extend the shared platform so it stays useful for every model, without project-specific logic leaking into shared code</li> <li>You set the engineering standards the platform runs on as it scales across the organisation</li> </ul> <h3>&nbsp;</h3> <h3>What you bring</h3> <ul> <li>4+ years in production machine learning engineering, with real ownership of models after handoff — not only training them</li> <li>Strong Python: typed, tested, production-grade code, and you review the work of others</li> <li>Enough machine learning depth to challenge a pipeline on problem framing, feature engineering, model selection and evaluation methodology</li> <li>Hands-on experience with a managed ML platform — SageMaker, Vertex AI, Databricks or Azure ML — plus feature stores, CI/CD for machine learning, AWS and Terraform</li> <li>An AI-native way of working: you use tools like Claude, ChatGPT or Copilot actively in your daily work</li> <li>English at C1 level, written and spoken. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always. ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages. ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models. Social travel : We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose. Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy. Co-working : If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend. You’ll bring structure to how we plan, deliver and measure enablement, from tracking OKRs and roadmaps to coordinating the enablement calendar, launches and certifications. You’ll also help keep the team aligned on priorities, manage cross-functional dependencies and use reporting to understand what’s working and where we can improve. Working closely with the Sales Enablement lead and partners across GTM, RevOps, Product Marketing and People, you’ll help turn priorities into well-run programmes that meet the needs of the business. This role is a great fit for someone who enjoys bringing order to complex projects, delivering engaging training and finding practical, creative ways to solve problems. Own GTM onboarding: Manage onboarding cohorts end to end, from scheduling and communications to facilitating live sessions, coordinating speakers and gathering feedback. jobs.description: Hi, we’re Bloom & Wild. We don’t just send flowers. We help our customers to care wildly. Caring wildly is celebrating the little things we all do for each other every day. Not just the big occasions. It’s being there for the highs. Stepping up for the lows.   We care wildly about people and our planet. Which is why we’re so proud to be a certified B Corp™ – committed to making long-term positive change for our community, and the world around us.   Founded in 2013, our mission back then was to make sending and receiving flowers the joy that it should be, by harnessing technology, brand and letterbox delivery. We announced £75 million Series D funding in 2021 and that same year acquired bloomon in The Netherlands and Bergamotte in France. Together, we’ve fulfilled and delivered over 20 million orders (and counting!), making us the largest direct to consumer flower business in Europe.   Now home to a family of 3 beautiful brands, we’re driven by our vision to create the destination for making life a little more thoughtful and beautiful. And we won't stop at flowers and plants. Starting with the Bloom & Wild brand, we're expanding our gifting offering to other categories like cakes, candles and cocktails. This is all part of our ambition to build Europe's #1 direct to consumer gifting destination.    🛠️ The Commercial Team @ Bloom & Wild Group  Our team cares wildly about delivering ambitious and profitable growth across all of our seven markets and three brands. We’re firmly focused on growing profitably, whilst also keeping an eye on the long term commercial view, and our wider business goals, in everything that we do. This may sound like a cliché, but we really are a bunch of fast-thinking problem-solvers. Think Deeply, Act Swiftly really comes into play in our team. Our Slack channels are full of threads of our team coming together to solve a problem, sharing knowledge and resources, and all working together for our shared mission. We know where we’re headed, and we’re all ready to jump in to support each other to get there. We develop our commercial strategy whilst managing day to day trading to have full country or category oversight. We’re a distributed team, and we currently have team members all across Europe & the UK! This role is based in our London or Amsterdam office with an expectation of being in the office 2 days a week (can be remote in Germany too), with full office presence and travelling to our Amsterdam office over peak timings. We work very frequently with almost all other functions across the business, so we’re really proud of our ability to collaborate effectively and are always looking for ways to connect and work together; making use of both our virtual tools and our lovely offices. We come together as a full team once a year in either London or Amsterdam for a team offsite, and throughout the rest of the year we gather in our respective country teams as frequently as we can!   💻 What you’ll be doing:  Reporting to our Commercial Director Germany & Austria, you'll own the trading function for Europe, one of our most important growth markets. You'll make sure we have the right stock every day, sell it to forecast and keep waste to a minimum. You'll also hold the pen on site pricing and make sure our website is set up to convert. You'll work across teams in a matrix structure, alongside our operations, central planning, range and product design teams, and play a key role in delivering our biggest peaks: Christmas, Valentine's Day and Mother's Day. It's a fast-paced, collaborative environment where no two days are the same and you can make an impact from day one. Some of the responsibilities include: Stock and forecasting: Managing our day-to-day and week-to-week stock position with our central planning, flower buying and operations teams, keeping availability strong and balancing supply when there are shifts in demand and customer preferences Maki

How long a patient waits for their prescription to be approved, or for a reply from a customer care agent. Whether there are enough coaches for the patients waiting. How many orders leave the pharmacy on time, and whether the stock is there to fill them. When a process changes, you’ll build the metrics that measure it and make sure the teams can trust them. We are seeking an experienced Technical Content Engineer to join our Customer and Product Education team. In this role, you will be the architect of our technical narrative and the systems behind it, ensuring our customers and the AI agents that increasingly serve them have the right information at the exact moment it's needed. You'll go beyond writing "how-to" articles ; you will design and organize a logic-driven knowledge base that serves two audiences, our customers and AI agents (including the Documentation Agent in the Pigment platform), and you'll own the quality of content for both. What you'll do: Own the Narrative: Write and edit logically structured, reader-focused documentation that aligns with our Style Guide, ensuring a consistent voice across all Pigment help resources, for both human readers and AI agents. Architect Information: Design intuitive content layouts and visual aids within our knowledge base, making strategic decisions on content length and structure to maximize user comprehension and self-service. Structure content so it can be reliably chunked, retrieved, and cited by AI agents, not only read by people. Innovate with AI: Stay ahead of the curve by exploring and implementing AI-driven workflows to streamline content creation, from drafting and quality checks to content audits, while keeping editorial judgment at the center. Train and Tune the Documentation Agent: Partner with Product and Engineering to improve the Documentation Agent in the Pigment platform. Curate source content, write and refine agent instructions and evaluation prompts, review agent answers for accuracy, and feed gaps back into the knowledge base. Run Docs as Code: Manage content through Git-based workflows (Markdown, pull requests, and automated checks for links, structure, and style) so documentation ships in step with product releases. Automate and Scale Content Operations: Build lightweight automation and AI-assisted workflows that reduce repetitive work, and make it easier for Product, Engineering, and Professional Services colleagues to contribute accurate documentation. We believe SRE engineers should collaborate closely with software engineers, fostering a shared understanding of day-to-day challenges, rather than operating in separate teams. Pigment engineers participate in the entire application development lifecycle, focusing on design, coding, and keeping the production platform up and running. jobs.title: UX/UI Designer (H/F)
jobs.description: A PROPOS DU POSTE Chez Winamax, nos parcours utilisateurs ne se limitent pas à des formulaires d'inscription ou des tunnels d'achat classiques. Qu'il s'agisse de nos fonctionnalités de Paris Sportifs, de nos tables de Poker, de nos opérations promotionnelles ou de nos mécaniques gamifiées, nous créons des interfaces transactionnelles à fort impact visuel et émotionnel . Pour soutenir la croissance de nos produits, nous renforçons nos équipes de design produit et recherchons des UI/UX Designers Ton pari au quotidien ? Rendre l'UX tellement évidente qu'elle s'oublie, et l'UI tellement bluffante qu'elle se remarque. DESCRIPTIF DU POSTE Nous recherchons un  Profil UI/UX Crafter, focalisé sur la fluidité d’intéractions complexes, l'impact visuel, la typographie, la scénarisation des promotions événementielles et la finition graphique haute fidélité.     sous la responsabilité du manager UX/UI, tu seras un des garants du niveau d'exigence visuel et ergonomique de nos applications : UI Craft & Direction Artistique applicative : Concevoir des interfaces mobile first à forte valeur créative pour nos produits et nos opérations promotionnelles gamifiées. Optimisation des parcours transactionnels : Fluidifier les étapes clés (recherche, prise de pari, inscription, jeu et interactions, mécaniques de récompense) sans sacrifier le plaisir visuel ni l'immersion. Micro-interactions & Polish : Imaginer les micro-animations et retours visuels qui apportent du dynamisme aux actions des utilisateurs (feedbacks de validation, victoires, animations d’interactions). Design System & Scalabilité : Enrichir, structurer et maintenir nos composants et tokens (Figma, variables, auto-layout) pour garantir une parfaite cohérence entre produits. Prototypage Haute Fidélité : Créer des maquettes interactives pour tester l'ergonomie, la hiérarchie visuelle et le comportement des fonctionnalités avant intégration. Collaboration & Recette "Pixel Perfect" : Travailler au quotidien en squad avec les PM, Graphistes, Animateurs et Développeurs pour garantir une intégration rigoureuse et fidèle aux maquettes.   PROFIL RECHERCHÉ Nous cherchons des designers capables d'allier rigueur UX applicative et excellence visuelle . Le portfolio est le cœur de ta candidature. Ce qui fera la différence : Sensibilité visuelle et UI affirmée : Maîtrise avancée de la hiérarchie visuelle, des grilles, de la typographie, de la couleur et de la mise en valeur de contenus événementiels (tu ne crées pas la DA mais l’écrin des diverses opérations). Culture Web & Mobile Product : Une solide connaissance des standards ergonomiques sur iOS, Android et Web Responsive, nourrie par une veille constante (Mobbin, Awwwards, Dribbble). Culture B2C et entertainment : Passionné de sport, de poker, des paris sportifs ou du jeu au sens large, tu dois respirer le gameplay. Sens du détail et du  Craft : Obsession du pixel perfect, des micro-feedbacks visuels et de l'exécution soignée. Compétences requises : Maîtrise experte de Figma (variables, tokens, auto-layout, composants complexes). Gestion handsoff (specs de composants, détails de feature, déclinaisons d’états…) Esprit mobile-first et compréhension des contraintes d'intégration (Full React). Capacité à équilibrer créativité visuelle et contraintes de conversion / UX transactionnelle. Appétence pour les nouveaux outils d'assistance au design (Agent figma, Claude Design, Cursor, Paper...). Savoir travailler en mode squad comme en mode commando au sein d'un univers vivant et passionné. CE QUE TON PORTFOLIO DOIT MONTRER Pour retenir notre attention, ton portfolio est obligatoire et doit comporter : Des maquettes UI d'applications web/mobiles montrant une grande maturité visuelle et une DA soignée. Des exemples de parcours complexes ou d'interfaces événementielles/gamifiées. Des prototypes ou vidéos montrant le travail sur les micro-interactions et les animations d'interface. jobs.title: IP Rights Manager
jobs.description: About Mistral Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms. We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited. The Role As a Legal Operations Specialist – Data Licensing on the IP & Licensing team, you will own the processes that let Mistral license content and data without slowing down. This role exists because we need someone who can turn legal analysis into repeatable workflows — managing rights, obligations, and restrictions across our growing dataset portfolio. You will work closely with the colleagues who negotiate our commercial and legal agreements, turning their work into clear metadata, tracked obligations, and automated systems. Your impact will be visible in how smoothly data moves into our AI products: fewer bottlenecks, clearer rights status, and one reliable record for every data agreement we sign. You will sit where copyright, data protection, and AI meet, making sure that as we acquire and use training data, we comply with EU and US law, respect third-party rights, and enforce the restrictions our contracts impose. In scope: clearing permissions for inbound data, reviewing and codifying contracts, maintaining a central rights-and-obligations database, and building AI-powered workflows that make all of this scalable. What You Will Do Clear inbound data usage requests by researching rights status, scope, obligations, and restrictions — including anonymization and data protection requirements — before data enters our systems. Review data-related agreements and codify their key terms into structured metadata, maintaining our template library and playbook alongside Legal. Assess whether specific AI use cases fall within the scope of third-party agreements, flag gaps, and recommend contract amendments. Build and maintain a central database that serves as the single source of truth for every signed data-related agreement. Track and manage compliance with ongoing obligations — permitted uses, confidentiality, re-use rights — automate our reporting, and administer master licensing partnerships. Verify provenance, ownership, and consent for acquired data, and identify obligations that require active monitoring. Monitor that Mistral clients and partners stay within their granted rights, operating the approval system that enforces legal restrictions. Design and run AI-powered workflows for contract review assistance, obligation extraction, and renewal alerts. What We're Looking For A bachelor's degree in law, publishing, information science, business, or a related field. 2–5 years of experience in copyright, permissions, licensing, legal operations, or contract administration — ideally in an AI, tech, or data-driven environment. Working knowledge of EU and US copyright law and contract administration, with demonstrated ability to interpret contracts independently. Meticulous attention to detail and discretion with confidential contracts, combined with strong project-management skills. Clear, direct communication and the initiative to anticipate needs through ambiguity. A legal-ops mindset: you want to turn legal analysis into repeatable, scalable processes, not just handle one-off reviews. Comfort building agentic AI workflows in a complex enterprise environment — you are an AI power user, ideally with experience setting up such workflows in a legal team. jobs.description: About Us Base360.ai is the AI operating system for short-term rental businesses, helping property managers run their operations on autopilot. Born out of The Flex, a short-term rental operator that scaled to an eight-figure business using its own software, Base360.ai is now launching as a standalone platform for short-term rental operators worldwide. We bring reservations, guest communication, pricing, payments, cleaning, maintenance, and reporting into one platform—helping operators automate manual work, reduce costs, increase revenue, and scale their portfolios. We're looking for an ambitious Senior Full-Stack Product Engineer who wants to turn real customer problems into intuitive, reliable software. You'll work closely with founders, designers, and operators to identify what matters, build solutions, and improve them based on how people use them. If you enjoy owning the full journey from customer problem to shipped product—and you're excited by AI, automation, and short-term rentals—we want to meet you. What You'll Build As a Senior Full-Stack Product Engineer, you'll help shape and scale Base360.ai across the entire short-term rental lifecycle. You'll build customer-facing features, operational dashboards, automation engines, AI-powered workflows, and integrations that help property managers grow without increasing their workload at the same rate. Your work will connect what users see with the systems behind it—from a guest’s check-in experience to the workflows coordinating reservations, cleaning, payments, and owner reporting. Your Mission Understand Customer Problems Work directly with property managers and internal teams to understand their workflows, identify friction, and decide which problems are worth solving. Build Products End-to-End Take features from idea and prototype through frontend, backend, integrations, testing, and deployment. Own the complete experience and how it performs in production. Create Intuitive User Experiences Work with designers to make complex short-term rental operations easy to manage. Build interfaces that help users complete tasks quickly and confidently. Create Powerful Automations Build event-driven workflows that eliminate repetitive work—from scheduling cleaning after a booking to sending check-in instructions and generating owner statements. Develop AI-Powered Features Use LLMs and AI agents to automate guest communication, triage maintenance requests, support pricing decisions, and help operators manage their portfolios more efficiently. Connect the Ecosystem Build reliable APIs and integrations with platforms including Airbnb, Hostaway, Stripe, Twilio, OpenAI, Google, and other partners across the short-term rental ecosystem. Solve Real Operational Problems Build solutions for: Real-time reservation and availability synchronization Dynamic pricing intelligence Smart lock access and key management Automated guest communication across channels Guest check-in and upsell journeys Operational forecasting Cleaning and maintenance automation Owner reporting and financial workflows AI-powered monitoring and alerts Measure and Improve Use customer feedback, product usage, and operational results to evaluate what you ship. Improve features based on adoption, time saved, fewer errors, and better user outcomes. Build for Scale Make sound technical decisions that balance delivery speed, maintainability, security, and reliability as more operators and properties join the platform. jobs.description: Company Description We’re Checkout.com . You might not know our name, but companies like eBay, Spotify, Klarna, Uber, and Sony do, because we’re behind many of the digital experiences you use every day. We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions yearly for more than one billion global shoppers. Whether you want to book a holiday, order food, renew a subscription, or check out online, there’s a good chance our tech powers the payments behind the scenes. Our platform helps the most ambitious businesses deliver effortless digital experiences, at scale. If you want to do career-defining work, you’ve come to the right place. We move fast, think globally, and believe great teams are built by hiring exceptional people with conviction, curiosity, and the desire to make an impact. With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started. About the role: As a Senior Software Developer at Checkout.com , you will be embedded within the Identity Verification Team, a critical function focused on building innovative products to verify the identities of individuals and businesses globally. In this high-impact role, you will be instrumental in the development of next-generation verification features, deploying intelligent, production-ready solutions by leveraging state-of-the-art Orchestration technologies as well as Generative AI and Computer Vision technologies. You will be expected to work closely and collaboratively with Product, DevOps, DataScientist, and Data teams to ensure successful, end-to-end delivery of these solutions, while constantly researching and integrating emerging technologies. A core part of your contribution will be safeguarding data integrity and ensuring compliance, and translating complex data insights into clear, actionable recommendations for stakeholders to support informed, data-driven decision-making across Checkout.com . What you will be doing: • Drive the design and development of innovative, complex and scalable applications for real-world identity verification challenges in a wider microservices using industry best practices. • Take full ownership of new and existing features and service, managing the end-to-end lifecycle from initial conceptualization and design through to deployment and monitoring in a production environment. • Actively collaborate with cross-functional teams (Engineering, Product, Risk) across the company to maximize the positive impact of data science initiatives. • Champion a culture of technical excellence, cross-team learning, and knowledge sharing within the Data organization. • Be part of, and collaborate with, cross-functional teams including product management, across a large engineering community. • Write clean, maintainable, extendable and testable code on some of Checkout’s most impactful systems. • Build, own and operate your systems to the highest levels of resilience and service. • Mentor junior team members and assist in their technical development What are we looking for: • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field • Over 5 years of experience as a Software Engineer working with complex, large-scale, and diversified applications and tech stacks. • Proficiency in C# .NET, with a strong understanding of software development principles in either a backend or full stack environment. • Great communication skills and ability to interact effectively with a wide range of stakeholders • Experience working in agile environments and delivering high-quality code within tight deadlines • Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to work independently as well as part of a team • Someone who is AI proficient or AI curious, you will be hungry to embrace what the latest technology has to offer to enhance yours and your teams productivity • Payments or financial knowledge is a plus, but not jobs.title: Computational Scientist / Scientific Machine Learning
jobs.description: Fusionality is building the measurement, simulation, and control stack for the fusion energy reactors of the future. Spun out of EPFL’s Swiss Plasma Center and backed by top investors, our technology enables reliable operation, real-time monitoring, and analysis of high-temperature plasmas in fusion devices. We are founded by world-class experts at the intersection of fusion physics, advanced control, and AI (ex-Google DeepMind, EPFL). We are assembling a founding engineering team in Lausanne to build our core technology platform. We are looking for a Computational Scientist specialized in Scientific Machine Learning (SciML) to join our team. This job is for you if you know how to write numerical solvers that are fast, correct and differentiable end to end, and want to see them run against real plasma data and inside real control systems. We are looking for a PhD-level or senior computational researcher for this role. Responsibilities Design, implement and validate differentiable solvers in JAX for plasma physics problems such as free-boundary equilibrium, transport and state estimation. Make them robust and fast enough for production use via advanced numerical techniques for differential equation time stepping, as well as optimization of GPU/TPU performance. Using automatic differentiation for model calibration against experimental data, parameter estimation and controller design and optimization, working with our data and control engineers. Code ownership: quality, testing, verification against reference solutions, packaging and documentation. Requirements Substantial code written in a differentiable framework. Our stack is in JAX, Julia or PyTorch experts are very welcome if they’re happy to switch. Strong background in numerical methods for ODEs and PDEs: discretisation, stiff and implicit solvers, nonlinear and sparse linear solvers. Demonstrated ability to operate at the frontier of SciML, Universal Differential Equations, Neural ODEs, and other emerging hybrid data-driven/mechanistic paradigms. Evidence of independent work at the highest level: a PhD or thesis, published code that is used by others, or an industry project you owned. Proficient using Agentic coding and other modern AI technologies to accelerate your work, while remaining accountable for the results. Experience in the following fields an advantage but not strictly required: The JAX ecosystem: Diffrax, Equinox, Optax, Lineax. Plasma, fluid, electromagnetic, or other multiphysics simulation. Having led the design of a scientific codebase used by others. What we offer Play a key role at a dynamic, fast-growing startup, shaping the technical solutions and products from the ground up. Build cutting-edge technology to monitor and control plasmas in real fusion devices, working side-by-side with leading plasma and control experts. Great working conditions, located in Lausanne, Switzerland, a city and country known for its high quality of life. Competitive salary and equity compensation and benefits including immigration assistance. Find Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow

Je bent dé persoon binnen de organisatie als collega’s financiële vragen hebben. Je geeft zowel gevraagd als ongevraagd advies aan de directie over marktontwikkelingen, trends en visies om het bedrijf te helpen groeien. De missie en visie van het bedrijf omzetten naar concrete doelen. jobs.title: Adviseur Loopbaan en Mobilteit
jobs.description: Als je goed zorgt voor je mensen, zorgen zij goed voor jou. Deze overtuiging van de oprichter van ADG Dienstengroep vormt de basis van Koersmakers. Koersmakers is een nieuw bedrijf dat werkt aan duurzame inzetbaarheid voor vakmensen, zodat zij maximale regie krijgen over het (werkende) leven. Om dit goed in de praktijk te brengen zijn we op zoek naar een adviseur in de regio Amsterdam/Rotterdam, Noord en Oost Nederland Omschrijving van het team Koersmakers is een jong, maar groeiend team van 9 collega’s. De mobiliteitsadviseurs Annemiek, Celine, Wilco, Miranda, Mariëlle, Dana en Inez, begeleiden ieder in hun eigen regio vakmensen in verschillende trajecten: van spoor 2 re-integratie tot (loopbaan)coaching en van gespreksbegeleiding tot leiderschapstrainingen. Zwaantje ondersteunt hen in de dagelijkse operatie en Sterre is kwartiermaker en eindverantwoordelijk voor Koersmakers. Taken Wat ga je doen? Als adviseur ga jij in de verschillende trajecten de verhalen, doelen en talenten van hun vakmensen naar boven halen. Op dit moment begeleid je hoofdzakelijk medewerkers in een Spoor 2 re-integratie traject. Tegelijkertijd worden we inmiddels ook steeds vaker gevraagd om vakmensen te begeleiden in (loopbaan)-coaching trajecten en bij gespreksbegeleiding. En die beweging naar preventieve dienstverlening omtrent de inzetbaarheid van vakmensen is precies de stap die ze de komende tijd samen met jou willen zetten. In de begeleiding van vakmensen maak je gebruik van passende (interesse)testen, waaronder de Predictive Index. Jij zet vervolgens dat wat iemand wil, drijft en kan, om naar concrete acties om de inzetbaarheid van deze vakmensen te vergroten en behouden. Hierbij houd je rekening met de actuele regels tot Wet Verbetering Poortwachter en de verzuimcyclus van het UWV. Daarnaast ondersteun je de leidinggevenden van de verschillende ADG bedrijven hoe zij samen met hen de regie van vakmensen op het (werkende) leven naar de praktijk kunnen brengen. Ze vinden het geen probleem als je geen tot weinig ervaring hebt met het gebruik van onze testen. Vereisten Wat ze wel belangrijk vinden: Je hebt ervaring met het uitvoeren van Spoor 2 re-integratie trajecten. Je vindt het leuk om te werken aan de duurzame inzetbaarheid van hun medewerkers. Vakmensen die werk doen wat vaak niet gezien wordt, juist als het écht goed gedaan wordt. Schoonmaakmedewerkers, onderhoudsmonteurs, hospitality professionals, BOA’s en zorgmedewerkers. Zij houden Nederland draaiend. Zij doen het voor hén. Jij zorgt dat de uitvoering van hun dienstverlening (in geval van Spoor 2 re-integratie) voldoet aan de eisen die de verzuimcyclus en de Wet Verbetering Poortwachter stelt. Je legt makkelijk contact met andere mensen, ook in onbekende situaties. Je toont interesse in wie zij zijn en kunt een leidende en sturende rol goed afwisselen met een luisterende en afwachtende rol. Je werkt zelfstandig, beschikt over probleemoplossend vermogen en neemt regie over de trajecten die je begeleidt. Je schakelt gemakkelijk met verschillende gesprekspartners en vertaalt doelen naar concrete stappen, ook wanneer de situatie nog niet volledig duidelijk is Je werkt gericht toe naar (nieuwe) mogelijkheden voor vakmensen om (weer) inzetbaar te worden en blijven. Je vertaalt doelen en mogelijkheden in concrete afspraken en houdt jezelf, medewerkers en leidinggevenden aan deze afspraken. Jij blijft je, ook bij weerstand of uitdagingen, inspannen om de inzetbaarheid van vakmensen te vergroten of behouden. Je werkt precies en zorgvuldig en signaleert bij onvolledigheden en afwijkingen in de begeleiding of rapportages. Hierbij schroom je niet om te benoemen wat je ziet en hoort, durf je kritische vragen te stellen, altijd met het doel om tot oplossingen en mogelijkheden voor inzetbaarheid te komen en altijd met respect voor de ander. Benefits Dit mag jeverwachten Een maandsalaris van EUR 3500 tot EUR 4500 op basis van 40 uur Een jaarcontract voor 24 tot 40 uur 27 vakantiedagen op basis van 40 uur

Je bouwt minder zelf en je beoordeelt meer. Founded in 2013, we are now the world’s largest online therapy service, providing affordable and convenient therapy across the globe. Our network of over 30,000 licensed therapists has helped millions of people take ownership of their mental health and change their lives forever. And we’re not stopping there – as the unmet need for mental health services continues to grow, BetterHelp is committed to being part of the solution. As the Manager of Business Analysis & Insights at BetterHelp, you’ll join a diverse team of licensed clinicians, engineers, product pros, creatives, marketers, and business leaders who share a passion for expanding access to therapy. And as a mental health company, we take employee mental health just as seriously as we do our mission. We deeply invest in our team’s well-being and professional development, because we know that business and individual growth go hand-in-hand. At BetterHelp, you’ll carve your own path, make an immediate impact, and be challenged every day – with a supportive community behind you the whole way. What are we looking for? We are seeking an experienced Manager, Business Analysis & Insights to serve as a strategic thought partner to the CFO and executive leadership team across BetterHelp. This role is best suited for someone who enjoys solving ambiguous problems, proactively identifying opportunities, and operating with a high degree of ownership in a fast-paced environment. We’re looking for someone with a strong passion for turning data into compelling narratives and a demonstrated ability to influence outcomes through cross-functional collaboration. Success in this role requires balancing analytical depth with speed. The ideal candidate knows when to dive deep and when to synthesize quickly, delivering insights that help leaders make better decisions without unnecessary complexity. What will you do? Executive Communication & Storytelling: Distill complex analyses into concise, executive-ready narratives, adapting communication to audiences ranging from individual contributors to the CFO, President, and executive leadership Strategic Analytics & Decision Support: Lead high-impact analyses that go beyond reporting metrics to identify root causes, quantify business opportunities, and develop actionable recommendations for executive leadership AI-Enabled Analytics : Leverage AI as a core part of the analytical workflow by leveraging modern AI tools to accelerate analysis, improve productivity, automate repetitive tasks, and increase the speed and quality of insights. Continuously evaluate new AI capabilities and champion thoughtful adoption across the team Business Strategy : Partner with business decision makers to shape and operationalize the company’s strategic roadmap, quantifying and accelerating impact on growth, efficiency, and profitability Analytics Infrastructure : Design scalable analytical frameworks, reusable datasets, automated pipelines, and self-service reporting that improve the organization’s ability to make decisions over time Influence Without Authority: Build trusted relationships across Finance, Product, Marketing, Data Science, and Engineering to drive alignment, unblock work, and move initiatives from analysis to execution Execution & Prioritization : Independently manage multiple concurrent initiatives, proactively prioritize work, navigate ambiguity, and balance short-term business needs with longer-term strategic opportunities What will you NOT do? jobs.title: Analytics Engineer
jobs.description: Reddit is a community of communities. It’s built on shared interests, passion, and trust, and is home to the most open and authentic conversations on the internet. Every day, Reddit users submit, vote, and comment on the topics they care most about. With 100,000+ active communities and approximately 130 million daily active unique visitors, Reddit is one of the internet’s largest sources of information. For more information, visit www.redditinc.com . We are looking for a talented and driven individual to be a key part of our Analytics Engineering team within the Data Science organization. We are looking for someone who can work closely with Data Scientists and Engineers across diverse areas of the organization (Consumer, Ads, and Marketing) to curate, develop, and deploy the right data and analytic tooling to drive Reddit’s product forward and provide a data and tooling foundation that will last decades. Your work will empower thousands of your colleagues to improve the user experience and grow our consumer base. Successful candidates have a strong track record of understanding and deeply caring about the purpose of data to support business goals, and can act as an effective conduit between Data Producers and Data Consumers. This role sits at the intersection of Data Science and Data Engineering, and the ideal candidate has skills, experience, and passion in both areas. Responsibilities: Be a key contributor and collaborator to the success of data quality, performance, reliability, and automation initiatives. Manage a portfolio of data products that deliver high-quality, trustworthy data Develop and maintain robust data pipelines and workflows for data ingestion, processing, and transformation. Work closely with engineering to ensure the quality and reliability of these data pipelines. Develop and implement data quality checks, conduct QA and implement monitoring routines Create and manage new data integrations across internal and external systems Create tools and applications for internal use that streamline data analysis and reporting. Drive widespread adoption of these tools and applications with a relentless focus on automation, consistency, and reliability. Serve as a thought partner for data scientists, engineering managers, and leadership on data foundations, communicating and shaping the data foundations roadmap and strategy for Reddit. Qualifications: Bachelor's degree in computer science or a quant educational field 3+ years of experience working with large-scale ETL systems (implementation, strategy, and maintenance), building clean, maintainable code and systems (Python preferred) in a production environment. Strong programming proficiency in Python, SQL, Spark, Scala, etc. Experience with data modeling, ETL and ELT concepts, and patterns for efficient data governance. Experience with manipulating massive-scale structured and unstructured data. Experience with data workflows (such as Airflow), data modeling, front-end or back-end engineering. Experience in data analysis and dashboard design. Deep understanding of technical and functional designs for relational and MPP Databases. Proven track record of cross-functional execution and collaboration. Agentic AI-assisted development experience. Excellent communication skills to collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders at all levels of the company, of differing levels of technical acumen. Self-starter, ability to work independently and autonomously, as well as part of a team. jobs.description: About Life360 Life360’s mission is to keep people close to the ones they love. Our category-leading mobile app, Tile tracking devices, and Pet GPS tracker empower members to protect the people, pets, and things they care about most with a range of services, including location sharing, safe driver reports, and crash detection with emergency dispatch. Life360 serves approximately 102.4 million monthly active users (MAU), as of June 30, 2026, across more than 180 countries. Life360 delivers peace of mind and enhances everyday family life with seamless coordination for all the moments that matter, big and small. By continuing to innovate and deliver for our customers, we have become a household name and the must-have mobile-based membership for families (and those friends who are basically family). Life360 has more than 500 (and growing!) remote-first employees. For more information, please visit life360.com . Life360 is a Remote First company, which means a remote work environment will be the primary experience for all employees. All positions, unless otherwise specified, can be performed remotely (within the US and Canada) regardless of any specified location above. We are AI Native We are building an AI native company where AI is an integral part of how we build and operate. AI tool usage during interviews varies by role. You may be asked to demonstrate proficiency with AI tools, discuss how you leverage AI, or complete interview exercises without AI assistance. Your Recruiter will provide clear guidance as you move through the interview process. Undisclosed use of AI not previously discussed with or approved by your Recruiter may impact your candidacy. We design, ship, and analyze high-velocity experiments across ads, subscriptions, and one-time purchases — pricing, paywalls, ad placement and mediation, upsell and upgrade flows — so every monetization decision is grounded in evidence, not instinct. Our work directly shapes the revenue behind nearly 100 million members. We are a product-minded, AI-Native engineering team. AI isn't just a tool we use — it's how we work. We treat it as a first-class collaborator at every stage: ideation, coding, testing, review, and iteration. We ship faster and go deeper because of it, and we're looking for someone who wants to help define what that looks like at scale. About the Job As a Lead Data Scientist, you will own the path from revenue opportunity to production ML for Direct Revenue, the business unit responsible for growing active users, subscriptions, revenue-generating transactions, and in-app advertising across Life360's more than 100 million monthly active users. In your first year, you will help the team scale the amount of production ML it delivers and help set the team's roadmap with the data science lead and the product manager. With $200+ million in annual revenue and team members based around the globe , Toptal is the world’s largest fully remote workforce . We take the best elements of virtual teams and combine them with a support structure that encourages innovation, social interaction, and fun. We see no borders, move at a fast pace, and are never afraid to break the mold. Job Summary: Toptal is looking for a Marketing Analyst to build and own the marketing data infrastructure to support new businesses and companies we acquire through M&A. The role is part of our Business Analytics Center of Excellence, where analysts are assigned to support one or more business functions. You will track paid advertising performance and translate it into metrics such as LTV and ROAS that inform budget allocation and channel strategy, from structuring the underlying data pipelines to developing the reports that help marketing and business leaders make data-driven decisions. Are you passionate about bringing rigor to how early-stage businesses measure and optimize acquisition spend from day one? If so, we encourage you to apply! This person will define the metrics that matter, measure channel and campaign performance, and develop reports that drive decisions. This Marketing Analyst needs to build positive relationships across the organization, manage diverse stakeholders with competing and often conflicting priorities, and have a “find a way” attitude. This is a remote position. We do not offer visa sponsorship or assistance. Resumes and communication must be submitted in English. Build, own, and maintain the marketing data infrastructure, from ad impression and click through lead acquisition to revenue, setting up and integrating Google Analytics, Google Ads, and other paid advertising platforms as required. Define metrics that are independent, holistic, accurate, encourage the right behaviors, and are aligned with company strategy and objectives, including consistent definitions of LTV, ROAS, and payback across businesses. jobs.title: Research Scientist
jobs.description: Who We Are Our mission is to make the world programmable. Sight is one of the key ways we understand the world, and soon this will be true for the software we use, too. We’re building the tools, community, and resources needed to make the world programmable with artificial intelligence. Roboflow simplifies building and using computer vision models. Today, over 1M+ developers, including those from half the Fortune 100, use Roboflow’s machine learning open source and hosted tools. That includes counting cells to accelerate cancer research, improving construction site safety, digitizing floor plans, preserving coral reef populations, guiding drone flight, and much more. Our team is small relative to our impact, and we believe our user success is our success (not the inverse). A team member summarized: “Roboflow is a company full of giant brains and tiny egos.” We find software has a multiplier effect on all roles (not only product and engineering), so Roboflow employs developers across the company in design, sales, customer support, marketing, and beyond. We’re supported by great customers and investors, having raised over 63 million from Google Ventures, Y Combinator, Craft Ventures, Sam Altman, Lachy Groom, amongst other leading software investors. What You'll Do As a Research Scientist, you will originate and drive the novel machine learning research directions that shape Roboflow's research agenda. Because of Roboflow’s huge userbase, we have a unique visibility into how people are using computer vision in the real world, including in what circumstances existing methods are unable to solve user problems. Our Research Team’s mission is to introduce novel methods that generalize as well as possible across our userbase. This includes methods that learn well on diverse data, run efficiently on different hardware targets, and solve unique categories of problems. You will identify the most promising open problems in computer vision, develop original theoretical approaches and algorithms to address them, and publish your work at top conferences. You'll partner closely with our engineering team, who will take your research and translate it into production systems running at scale. Who You Are You are a pragmatic, experienced machine learning researcher who wants to be an important part of an exceptional team that focuses on using Roboflow's computer vision tools to impact and improve every industry. You have high agency and a bias toward action. Masters / PhD in AI, machine learning, computer vision, robotics, or similar technical field of study, or equivalent industry experience History of publication at conferences / journals (CVPR, NeurIPS, ICLR, etc.) Deep understanding of ML theory and a track record of turning open problems into novel, well-formed research directions Values scientific rigour and reproducibility Passionate about computer vision and solving problems users value Pragmatic approach to utility in practice (not just in theory) Cares about open source and the broader research/developer ecosystem Writes and communicates clearly — able to explain your work to the scientific community, the developer community, and non-research stakeholders inside Roboflow Preferred but not required: Familiarity with the practical constraints of optimizing models for edge hardware and training models on distributed infrastructure Experience collaborating with engineering teams to move research from prototype to production Where You'll Work Roboflow’s team is distributed across the world. We currently have Hubs in New York City, San Francisco, and Brazil (and plan to open more as we grow density in new cities). We provide opportunities (like team onsites in different cities) and resources (like a $4000/yr travel stipend) to work in person with other team members as much as you'd like, while also supporting remote team members. You can work from one of our Hubs (we offer a relocation bonus), work from home, work at co-working spaces, etc. W

jobs.title: Sr. Data Engineer
jobs.description: About Carrot : Carrot is the leading global fertility and family care platform, built on intelligent care orchestration: the right clinical guidance, at the right moment, in the context of each member’s life. More than a thousand multinational employers, health plans, and health systems trust Carrot to support millions of members across 195 countries – from pre-pregnancy through menopause and major life moments in between. Carrot's comprehensive clinical program delivers industry-leading cost savings for plan sponsors and award-winning experiences and improved outcomes for millions of people worldwide. Carrot is widely regarded as a defining force in healthcare innovation as a recipient of several top-tier awards, including Fast Company's 'Most Innovative Companies' and CNBC's '100 Barrier Breaking Startups'. The company is regularly cited by leading global outlets — including The Economist, Bloomberg, The Wall Street Journal, NPR, ABC News, and Harvard Business Review — as a leading voice on digital health, the future of work, and family health. Learn more at get-carrot.com . The Opportunity Carrot is seeking a Sr. Data Engineer to lead the evolution, reliability, and scalability of our modern data infrastructure across analytics, reporting, and business intelligence. In this role, you will architect, build, and maintain robust, automated data pipelines, orchestrate workflows, integrate diverse data sources, and partner with stakeholders across the business to deliver secure, compliant, high-quality data solutions. Your work will span the full data lifecycle, from architecting resilient ETL/ELT pipelines and developing real-time and batch data integrations to automating reporting, reducing technical debt, and enabling advanced analytics. Sr. Data Engineers at Carrot are operational stewards and technical mentors, driving improvements in system maturity, cost efficiency, automation, and collaborative practices. You will join our Data Engineering team, which develops and optimizes scalable data pipelines and cloud infrastructure to enable secure, automated reporting and analytics across Carrot. The team collaborates closely with Business Intelligence, Product, Finance, Legal, and Commercial partners to deliver reliable integrations and self-serve solutions that drive business insights and operational efficiency. What You’ll Own In this role, you will: Architect, build, test, deploy, and maintain scalable, automated ETL/ELT pipelines using Python, dbt, and orchestration tools such as Prefect and Airflow Administer and optimize cloud-based data warehouse and lake platforms, including Snowflake, AWS (S3, Redshift), and Google Cloud, integrating new sources and tuning for performance and cost Orchestrate data workflows with custom scheduling, alerting, dependency management, monitoring, and error resolution Design and maintain secure external data flows through SFTP, Files.com, and APIs, with a focus on reliability and compliance Automate manual reporting and operational tasks, building robust, reusable pipeline components that reduce operational overhead Partner with backend product engineers to optimize production database schemas with analytics use cases in mind Strengthen data quality, lineage, governance, and documentation practices across key data domains Mentor teammates and reinforce best practices in version control, code review, and structured workflow management What Success Looks Like In your first 12–18 months, you will have: Taken end-to-end ownership of core pipelines and integrations, with measurable improvements in reliability, data recency, and cost efficiency Automated high-effort manual workflows, reducing operational risk and freeing capacity for higher-value engineering work Delivered secure, compliant data integrations that stakeholders across the business trust for decision-making Strengthened observability across the platform, including monitoring, alerting, and incident response for critical data workflows

jobs.description: Join our elite team of Senior Raters as a critical contributor to high-quality validation data that directly influences product development and quality assurance for leading search engines and AI technologies. This flexible, remote opportunity allows you to apply your analytical and research skills to evaluate search results and AI-generated content while contributing to the development of high-quality AI systems. Meet productivity expectations while maintaining high-quality work. jobs.description: About the Role Elite Editing is seeking experienced freelance journalists and content professionals to support our growing customer reference and case study programs. We call this our Storyteller role, and we are specifically looking for experienced professionals based in EMEA and APAC time zones . Our Storytellers own the storytelling process from interview through finished draft. They lead kickoff calls with our clients and their internal stakeholders, interview their customers and subject matter experts (SMEs), identify the strongest narrative angles within the information they gather, and then write compelling case studies and customer reference stories that adhere to client-specific standards and style guides. This is more than simply working through a list of prepared questions—or turning a transcript into copy. We need skilled storytellers who listen closely, recognize when an answer deserves further exploration, ask intelligent follow-up questions, identify the details that make a story worth telling, and then shape that material into polished, engaging content. Our ideal freelancer has a journalism or professional interviewing background paired with extensive professional writing experience and strong editorial judgment . You should be comfortable speaking with senior business leaders, technical SMEs, and other professionals; able to quickly understand unfamiliar or complex subject matter; and skilled at transforming what you learn into a clear and compelling narrative. Review project background materials and prepare for interviews in advance. Use provided interview guides as a starting point while adapting questions to the conversation. Ask thoughtful, unscripted follow-up questions that uncover meaningful details, examples, outcomes, challenges, and quotable insights. Identify and develop the strongest story angles from interviews, background materials, and client input. Write polished B2B case studies and customer reference stories based on the information you gather, following client-specific briefs, templates, standards, and style guides. Synthesize complex or technical information into accurate, accessible, and engaging narratives for the intended audience. Maintain a professional, confident, and personable presence while representing Elite and our clients on calls. Work collaboratively with Elite's project managers, editors, and other members of the content team throughout the development and revision process. Job Requirements Successful candidates must: Have substantial professional writing experience , with a portfolio demonstrating the ability to develop clear, engaging, publication-ready content. Be comfortable interviewing senior executives, business leaders, customers, and subject matter experts. Be able to absorb unfamiliar information quickly and ask credible, informed questions about complex topics. Have strong editorial judgment and be able to identify the narrative, details, and supporting evidence that will make a compelling story. jobs.title: Supervisor, Revenue Cycle - Prior Authorization
jobs.description: Supervisor, Prior Authorization Job Summary The Supervisor, Prior Authorization is responsible for overseeing the daily operations and performance of teams supporting the Prior Authorization function within Natera 's Billing Operations department. This position provides direct operational oversight of the Prior Authorization teams, including both domestic and offshore employees. The Supervisor is responsible for ensuring timely and accurate resolution of prior authorization issues, managing team productivity and quality, monitoring payer requirements, and driving operational improvements that support authorization compliance and minimize reimbursement delays. This role partners closely with internal stakeholders and external teams to resolve escalated issues, identify process inefficiencies, and optimize prior authorization workflows. Key Responsibilities Oversee the daily operations of teams responsible for the full Prior Authorization function (submissions, denials and appeals, etc.) ensuring efficient workflow management, timely case resolution, and adherence to departmental performance standards. Provide day-to-day leadership, coaching, and performance management for both domestic and offshore team members, ensuring consistency in processes, quality, and productivity across teams. Monitor team performance against established KPIs, including productivity, turnaround times, case resolution rates, quality, backlog management, and other operational metrics. Oversee the review, investigation, and resolution of prior authorization denials, including coordination of appeals, identification of denial trends, and implementation of corrective actions to reduce recurring issues. Ensure timely identification, investigation, and resolution of prior authorization discrepancies, mismatches, and other authorization-related issues that may impact claim processing or reimbursement. Monitor work queues, case volumes, and aging inventory to ensure appropriate workload distribution, timely follow-up, and resolution of outstanding authorization cases. Serve as an escalation point for complex prior authorization issues, payer disputes, authorization discrepancies, and other operational challenges requiring additional investigation or cross-functional coordination. Collaborate with internal teams, including Billing, Insurance Verification, Denials & Appeals, and other Revenue Cycle functions, to resolve authorization-related issues and improve end-to-end billing workflows. Partner with offshore team leads and operational stakeholders to ensure alignment on workflows, performance expectations, training, quality standards, and escalation procedures. Identify trends and root causes contributing to prior authorization denials, authorization mismatches, processing delays, and other operational inefficiencies; recommend and implement process improvements. Ensure team adherence to payer-specific authorization requirements, internal policies and procedures, documentation standards, and applicable healthcare regulations. This is accomplished in an environment that is respectful of student, the Faculty Member, Walden University, and the discipline in which the Faculty Member is involved. Faculty Members are expected to adhere to all Walden University Faculty expectations, which are clearly set forth to the Faculty Member at the start of his/her employment with the University. What to Expect as a Walden Faculty Member! Essential Duties and Responsibilities Provide course instruction, course content development, and other curricular activities as needed Provide residency instruction. Provide academic advising and mentoring. Promote a social work professional identity with students. Engagement in scholarship Training All new faculty members receive specific training from Walden University in the techniques of online teaching; use of an electronic learning platform; specifics of the policies, procedures, and degree programs of the School or College in which they are going to teach; socialization into the Walden University culture; assessment of academic integrity of student work (including use of www.turnitin.com); and research supervision of theses and dissertations. Teaching and mentorship assignments are contingent upon successful completion of required training. During the first term of teaching, faculty members may be assigned a faculty peer mentor (senior colleague) as an extension of their new instructor training. Peer mentors will continue to support instruction and provide peer reviews of the classroom on a regular basis. Course Teaching/Availability Faculty members are assigned courses, which are taught using the Learning Management System (LMS) and are responsible for interacting with students within the LMS. Discussion Boards for classrooms are open 24 hours per day, 7 days per week. Faculty members are expected to be in the classroom a minimum of 4 days per week and responses to student questions must be posted within 48 hours. The university suggests regular and predictable availability, such as online office hours or regular online chats; office hours may be required based on program or college policy. Residencies Graduate-level faculty may be invited to attend Residencies held domestically or internationally, where they will teach face-to-face intensives and colloquia, and facilitate school and university-wide discussions. Contributing (part-time) faculty may be invited to participate but are not required to attend. Completes other duties as assigned. Tools/Technical Skills To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Incumbents will be evaluated, in part, based on performance of each essential function. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform essential functions. Licensing/Certification Faculty members must be appropriately credentialed, possess an earned degree from an accredited institution or an institution that is recognized by a country's ministry of education in the discipline being taught, and may be expected to be licensed or license-eligible to teach in specific programs. Faculty members must maintain their licenses and any appropriate certifications to continue to teach at Walden University. Faculty members are also expected to maintain currency with research by reviewing articles, journals, and presentations.
